Meanwhile, Hanna and Sean have made up, though Sean is still wary of her hanging out with Lucas, even if it is for the yearbook. Hanna lets Aria know that Sean's friend, Noel , wants to ask her out and tries to convince her to double date after school. Things progress with Maya and Emily as well, as Emily musters the courage to ask Maya out on a date for dinner and a movie. More good news for Emily is that her father's unit in Afghanistan is returning to the United States, meaning that Wayne is coming home.  In her room, Spencer looks at Alison's name bracelet for inspiration in writing her speech for Alison's memorial. She flashes back to who else was at the beach that day. Jenna had come to start a barbecue, wearing her now familiar shades, then taking them off. Alison expressed her annoyance, and Emily commented on Toby's conspicuous absence. When Alison responded by mocking him in conversation, Spencer rolled her eyes and pointed out how typical it was of Alison to taunt others. But, she softened when the girls all agreed that this day was perfect and then shared their dream that they would be friends until they grew old. Back in real time, Spencer receives a text from "A". " SUBJECT: THE DEDICATION DO IT RIGHT. I'LL BE WATCHING. JUST LIKE TOM SAWYER. --A "Threatening her to do the memorial right.  Hanna tries to convince Aria to go on the double date with her, Sean , and Noel , reminding the crush Aria had on Noel in middle school. Aria recalls how deeply she used to crush on Noel, and she accepts Hanna's date offer. She flashes back to that same summer day and remembers how the girls had spotted Noel with a girl named "Prudence." Alison had torn into her too, suggesting that she was anything but chaste with Noel, and provocatively suggested that she had gotten a boob job. Aria had ogled at Noel applying sunblock to her enviously. As if reading her mind, Alison asked if she would "also" do something like that to get Noel's attention. She then teased Aria for falling for brainy guys. She also called Noel immature and simultaneously perfect for Aria, flustering her. Ali said she preferred more mature guys. Meanwhile, Officer Wilden returns, visiting Hanna while she works on the yearbook. He tries to intimidate her into revealing Toby's whereabouts, which he suspects she might know, being Emily's friend. The possibility is far-fetched, and it is revealed that Officer Wilden is desperate to make progress in Alison's murder investigation. Jason's return has put extra pressure on the Rosewood Police Force to solve this case finally. Hanna coolly responds to his harassment, threatening to mention to Jason how Officer Wilden used to parade around her house in a towel. In the library, Spencer corners Jenna to try to feel out what Jenna is thinking about volunteering to give a speech for Alison's upcoming memorial. Jenna is snide towards her, preying on her fears of having " The Jenna Thing " made public. The conversation shifts from civil to menacing, and Spencer warns Jenna not to make a debacle out of the solemn ceremony for her beloved friend. At this, Jenna lets Spencer know that while she may have loved Alison, Alison had been with Spencer at the time of her death; mysteriously, she had told Jenna so in the hospital during the summer that she disappeared.  While Lucas is helping Hanna, she remembers who else Alison had picked on that summer day. When Lucas had run in front of them to pick up his toy motor boat, she had incessantly made offensive comments to him. Finally, Hanna had exclaimed "hey" as if to stand up to Alison and stop her from teasing him, but she recoiled and sat silent. Alison then turned on her, warning her never to let a moment pass, as Lucas trudged away.  Later, Byron visits Ashley at home to give her money. At first, Ashley balks at the thought of Hanna discussing their financial matters with Aria, but relaxes when she realizes that it is only for the memorial. Ashley then commiserates with Byron on his marital woes, bonding over their comparable experiences.  Back at school , Spencer and Emily talk to Jason about Alison and the memorial. They discuss their different relationships with Alison, all of which are equally important to consider during the memorial. Jason looks at the situation mainly from his own perspective and sees the girls as his sister's close club of friends with secrets. Detective Wilden and some other police officers rummage through Toby's locker. Clearly, they have received a search warrant. Jason walks over to frazzle Detective Wilden and accuse him of having zero leads in the murder investigation. Desperate to defend himself, Darren reveals that Toby had called Alison the night she disappeared. Jason tries to appear impassive, but the girls are stunned by this detail. That night, Emily recalls more of Alison's snide remarks from that unforgettable summer day. As she puts on the scarf that Maya gifted her, she remembers how Alison had commented on the couple, Noel and Prudence, heading to what they assumed was The Kissing Rock. Alison had matter-of-factly informed Emily that people had been going there to kiss for hundreds of years. Then, she looked daringly into Emily's eyes and asked her who she would like to take to The Kissing Rock . Emily smiled shyly and gazed back at her. Later at Hanna's house , Hanna pushes an uneasy Aria closer to Noel Kahn . Whether for reasons of missing Ezra or family issues, Aria is distant during dinner. Noel confronts Aria about her cold behavior, suspecting Aria of being stuck on a boy in Iceland . Aria plays along, as the truth is close enough, and realizes aloud that she needs to move on (from Ezra), as that relationship will never be what she wants it to be and can only end badly. Aria mentally lets go and gives Noel a chance. Then, Lucas briefly stops by, giving Sean pause. Hanna claims it is for the yearbook, but really, Lucas has dropped off the cash proceeds from Hanna's old handbags. When Ashley comes home, she is stunned to see a fully stocked fridge and is upset to learn that Hanna sold her belongings. She expresses appreciation, but asks Hanna never to do it again, as it makes her feel inadequate as a provider. At the Rosewood Movie Theater , Emily and Maya enjoy their first official date. It isn't long before the two of them start making out during the film.  Next, Spencer speaks to Jason alone, discussing Alison and the prospect of putting away her killer. Jason confesses that he thinks that imprisoning the killer would not provide closure, as nothing can change the fact that his 15-year-old sister was murdered. But Spencer believes justice is worth something. At the mention of justice, Jason balks, accusing Spencer of being a hypocrite, when Ali had told him that she instigated " The Jenna Thing " and was the one who threw the stink bombs and threatened Toby into silence. Later, Spencer remarks on the convenience of Alison's cover-up to her friends; Spencer had threatened to expose Ali if Alison exposed Spencer's relationship with Ian. If she could convince people that Spencer was the guilty one, Spencer's threats would be rendered ineffective. The girls feel less closure than ever, knowing that Ali had created so much lasting trouble for them.  At the memorial, the girls are stunned by the sudden reappearance of Ian , Melissa’s ex, but even more surprised when Jenna takes the stage after Spencer, Hanna, Emily, and Aria. As they wait with bated breath and anxiousness as to what she will say, or worse yet, spill - in the end, she offers quite possibly the kindest words for their dearly departed friend. Whether her moving speech was actually sincere, the Pretty Little Liars can’t be sure, because it could just as easily be another trick up Jenna’s sleeve. After the memorial, Jason stops by Spencer's house to thank the girls. Given what Spencer has shared with them, the girls are cautious around him, but they do accept his gift: the "Alison" friendship bracelet that Alison was wearing on the day she died. It soon becomes clear to the girls that the beaded "Alison" bracelet they had previously found must have been a fake, made by someone like "A." At the end of the episode, Alison's memorial is being badly trashed by someone in black. " A ?"

title: The Perfect Storm
summary: There was a storm brewing in Rosewood last night, and not just one of the weather variety. The beginning of the episode starts with Hanna , Spencer , and Aria studying for the SATs. Spencer wants to study hard, but Hanna tries to convince Aria to date Noel Kahn. They ask about Alex, and Spencer is now also distracted. Then Veronica walks in and asks where Emily is. Emily is noticeably absent, and she arrives home muddy and super distressed. She gets an ominous text from " A ": "THERE'S ONLY SO MUCH YOU CAN BURY, EMILY. YOU'RE NOT DONE WITH ME YET.-A ". The next morning, Veronica escorts the girls into Rosewood High , leery of why the test is going to be administered as planned, with a hurricane brewing outside. There, she has a strange run-in with Spencer's new beau Alex , and the two share a familiar glance that alludes to a previous encounter. Spencer senses tension from Alex, and he seems to start avoiding her. Detective Wilden arrives and notifies the girls that Alison's memorial bench has been destroyed. Then he talks to Emily alone and takes note of her muddy shoes. In the library, the three girls are discussing recent events. Hanna believes that A has vandalized Ali's memorial, while Spencer still suspects that A could be Toby. As they continue their conversation, Emily walks in. She lies to the girls, claiming that the reason she didn't come to Spencer's house to study was that she went to bed early after a long practice the night before.  Aria gets a surprise of her own when she spots Ella , there as a volunteer proctor for the exam. Ella explains that she is going to teach at the high school because she needs the job. A tense moment is shared as both are still resentful of Ella's sudden move out of the house. Aria has been avoiding visiting Ella's new place, not wanting to validate her mother's decision to separate from Byron. Byron calls Ashley when the power goes out on his side of the street. Ashley, who had been reviewing her finances, lies and says she was ordering something from a catalog. She invites him over to use her fax machine. Hanna and Lucas grow closer as Lucas continues to score Hanna big bucks by selling her used accessories on the internet. But Mona is not enthusiastic about this new relationship development and mercilessly taunts Lucas, calling him "hermie" and "shim," names that had Alison made up. The girls are studying in the library when Emily receives a text from "A". " HEY EM -- YOU WEREN'T THE ONLY ONE WITH GREAT EXPECTATIONS. Check it out. xoxo --A ". Then, Detective Wilden questions the girls about their whereabouts last night. Emily says they were all studying at Spencer's, and the other girls covered for Emily without knowing why. They lie and claim that she was studying with them, although they are weirded out by Emily's secretiveness about what she was really doing, when even they don't know the truth. They question Emily and she reacts defensive that she said she was home last night, but why can't she say that to Darren? Emily gets up and says she goes to the restroom, but instead she heads to the stacks to find a copy of Great Expectations , a hint she got in the text from "A". Inside the book, she sees the letter she sent Alison shortly before her death. After this, Spencer receives a text from "A": " DEFINE DESERTION." SEEMS LIKE YOU'RE ABOUT TO LOSE EMILY. WHO'S NEXT? --A ". Warning her about losing Emily, she shows it to Aria and Hanna. Spencer sees Alex and attempts to discuss the strange situation involving her mother, but he insists that it's not his place to speak on the matter. Meanwhile, Mona continues to tease Lucas until Hanna reveals that she knows Mona's new handbag was bought on eBay. In response, Mona pretends that she was aware of this all along and claims to have purchased Hanna's bag as a joke. After it has become clear that the SAT is being postponed and they are stuck in the school, Noel convinces Aria to sneak out from the crowd and join him in an empty classroom. Back at the Marin household, Byron attempts to send the fax when the power goes out there, too. They commiserate about being single parents, and Ashley assures him she won't take sides if he and Ella wind up divorcing. Noel showcases his musical talent to Aria by playing the guitar while she begins to sing. Meanwhile, Emily sits alone in the library. As she glances at a book, a memory is triggered, taking her back to a time when Alison had been reading the same novel in the library. Emily had joined Alison on the floor, where Alison affectionately stroked Emily's hair. During that moment, Emily shared her dream that Jenna could regain her sight. Alison responded, saying something along the lines of, "That's why I love you, Emily." She then read a passage about Pip's intense love for Stella, explaining how he loved her despite all reason, even though she often played hard to get and offered him little hope for a future, aside from her teasing. Fittingly, Emily leaned in to kiss Alison, similarly expressing her own deep feelings. To Emily's delight, Alison smiled in return. Aria displays musical talent of her own, singing along to Noel's playing. They share some kind words of understanding and grow closer. A moment of attraction brings them to almost kiss, but the elusive Ezra walks in on them, interrupting their moment. A possibly suspicious Noel leaves, but Aria stays behind for an explanation from Mr. Fitz. He explains he went to New York to deal with family issues, then admits they were his "issues," and had time to think about the consequences of their relationship. He says things need to change. Aria says they already have and walks out, holding back tears. Byron invites Ashley to join him at a faculty dinner at a Moroccan restaurant since Ella won't be attending. The students had to walk into the locker room due to a tornado warning. Mona talked to Hanna and kept mocking Lucas. Fed up, Hanna pulled Mona aside and called her a hypocrite for treating someone of lesser social status so heartlessly, especially considering they used to be in the same position themselves. Meanwhile, Spencer spoke to Alex in the locker room, asking if they would be okay. She also inquired about what had happened between him and her mother. Alex explained that he couldn't provide details; it was up to Veronica to share that information. While reading the love letter, Emily remembers when she had been in the locker room with Alison alone. Alison had been changing; she had removed her towel and stood there topless while mentioning how she bought her bra in a French catalog, forcing Emily's already attentive eyes to stare. She had asked Emily to hook it, and after doing so, Emily had kissed her neck. Alison immediately turned on her, (feigning shock) and cruelly let Emily know that their kiss meant nothing more to her than practice for "the real thing." Abashed, Emily had turned, poised to leave, but Alison wouldn't let her escape the moment, reminding Emily that she was supposed to be giving her a ride home. Defeated and humiliated, Emily nevertheless remained, showcasing Alison's control over her friends. Back in real time, Emily hears some mysterious noises that spook her. She dodges books as they fall from the stacks, and when she returns to the aisle where she had been, she realizes that her bag and the letter are missing. Meanwhile, Ella walks in on Mr. Fitz in a storage closet searching for supplies and introduces herself. She commends him for his dedication to driving from New York in this weather. Ella mentions her separation from her husband and asks Ezra if he has noticed any changes in Aria lately. He replies that he hasn't and tells her that Aria is a very engaged student. She expresses her relief that Aria has an adult in her life whom she can admire. Emily finally arrives in the locker room, and Hanna immediately asks where she has been this whole time. Emily reacts that she was looking for her purse. Hanna says Emily can tell Aria and Spencer that she was with Maya last night, and they will accept her. Then Detective Wilden secretly confiscates Emily's belongings and corners her in the locker room, where the students are supposed to be congregated for safety reasons; he forces her to report to a classroom for questioning. Although uninvited, the other girls follow, suspicious of the detective's shadiness. There, he accuses Emily of trashing Alison's memorial and even casts aspersions as to whether she murdered Alison. He pulls out the detached pieces of Alison's memorial and exposes Emily's letter to her friends. Flustered and pushed by Wilden, Emily confesses that she loved Alison more than a friend, but never intended any harm towards her. She felt bad about the mean things she wrote in that letter and went to Alison's memorial seeking closure and forgiveness. By the time she arrived, it had already been vandalized, and she took the figurines from the statue in her bag because they were the only pieces of the memorial that weren't broken. Just then, Veronica walks in, outraged that the girls' safety has been compromised when they should be in the locker room during this storm. She gives Detective Wilden a piece of her mind and blasts him for trying to interrogate minors without an adult present; doesn't he know anything they say would not be admissible in a court of law? The girls are quick to chime in and exclaim the absurdity of accusing sweet Emily of murdering Alison, never mind stealing her bag without a search warrant. It seems that Detective Wilden will be off the case. By the end of the episode, much has been revealed. Unlike other members of the Hastings family, Veronica is quite a fan of Alex. After she had cancerous cells removed from her breast, unbeknownst to her family, she got drunk and visited the club , where Alex patiently listened to her anxieties. Veronica is grateful to Alex and gives Spencer her approval of their relationship after including her in the secret. Spencer is supportive of her mother's confession and later kisses Alex in appreciation without explaining why. At the Marin house, where Byron and Ashley are trying to fax the documents, the lights turn on again. Byron thanks Ashley and says he will drive Hanna to school all week. He also asks her to have that work dinner, but backs out of that plan immediately by saying he has a scrimmage game where he has to be. They agree to figure out something. At school, Aria approaches Noel and tells him she wants to go on a date. She mentions that she is having dinner with her mom on Friday, but asks if he is available on Saturday. Noel agrees. Meanwhile, we see Spencer kissing Alex, and Emily places the book back on the shelf. Hanna and Lucas have a conversation about their selling business, then he thanks Hanna for standing up to him to Mona, Hanna says he doesn't have to thank her because he is her friend. He looks like he wants to tell her something as she walks away. Then the camera focuses on Lucas' muddy shoes. Was he the one who trashed Alison's memorial? The black-gloved figure anonymously sends a file to the Rosewood Police Department . The file contains footage of Alison on the day that she disappeared. A is scrawled at the top of the envelope, then the remaining letters are filled in to read Anonymous, leaving little doubt that the black-gloved figure and "A" are the same.

title: Keep Your Friends Close
summary: At school , Mona delivers invitations for her camping birthday party on Saturday to her friends in the hallway. Of course, Hanna plans to go, but the rest of the girls are not planning to attend Mona's party, not caring much for attitude-driven Mona. They apologize to Hanna, but then " A " sends a message that they will also be in attendance and that the party is a scavenger hunt for "A". " You found my bracelet. Now come find me. Good luck bitches. " After school, Hanna discusses with her mother their strapped financial situation. Ashley doesn't want to reveal just how deep their money problems are, but Hanna gets an idea when she presses redial on the house phone to hear that she just called the delinquent accounts department of a mortgage company. Then, Mona comes over, hoping to convince Hanna to ditch school with her and celebrate her birthday by going shopping at designer stores and having lunch at Rive Gauche . Ashley, though tight on cash, proudly forks over $100 to her daughter when she hears Hanna refusing to join Mona based on the fact that things have been tight for them lately. She expresses disapproval over the idea of ditching school, though.   At the Montgomery's household , Byron is struggling to keep up with his new responsibilities as a single parent. Aria is attempting to work on the overwhelming pile of laundry. Things are also still awkward between Byron and Ella , as the latter has asked him for space. Byron wants to join Aria on her lunch with Ella.  At the Hastings' residence , Melissa informs Spencer that she is aware Ian is back in town. She wants to know why Spencer didn't tell her, but Spencer counters that it's not as if they are friends. Melissa reveals Ian asked her out, but she turned him down, as she's still getting over Wren and doesn't trust Ian after he broke her heart. Spencer apologizes about Wren, but Melissa doesn't take it to heart. Then, Spencer flashes back to the previous summer when she had been practicing her field hockey swing on the front lawn. Ian walked by, and under the pretense of correcting her technique, he put his arms around her waist and leaned in to kiss her neck. Surprised, Spencer turned around to face him. This, too, ended in a series of kisses. Ian walked away, then Alison called out from where she was standing a few meters away to let Spencer know she saw her kissing her sister's boyfriend. She called it disgusting and basically called Spencer a skank.  In school, Aria stands in the cafeteria, talking to Noel . He asks her out, and she accepts, planning a date for the weekend. Her budding feelings for him are complicating her uncertain relationship with Ezra . Ezra sees the two talking, then makes a remark about him being on the football team when Aria walks past him. Aria defends Noel's character and the appeal, but he says she can be with whoever she wants to be with. He is clearly not thrilled to see her with someone else though.  Next, the girls are called to the principal's office, once again, for questioning by the police. This situation compels Hanna to text Mona to let her know that she has to cancel their shopping date because she must remain in the office at school. Mona had previously warned her that she wouldn't be forgiving if Hanna backed out, and, true to her word, Mona replies with, "Screw you."Then, an FBI agent named Agent Cooper arrives; she has been enlisted as the representative of the FBI to assist the Rosewood Police in the murder mystery. Her approach to questioning is far milder than that of Officer Wilden . She does not seem accusing, instead wanting information. She shows them footage (sent by an anonymous source to the Rosewood Police Department) of Alison on the day she disappeared. In the video, she is calling someone (a guy) and teasing him that he wants to kiss her. In the video, it becomes clear that the girls didn't know who Alison's secret guy was; Spencer calls him 'the older guy'. She asks the girls to provide as much information as they can to illuminate the findings. The girls are cooperative. Hanna, ever the fashionista, lets Agent Cooper know she is positive that the sweater Alison takes off in the video did not belong to her.  And, having given Hanna the entire contents of her wallet that morning, Hanna’s mother, Ashley, grows increasingly desperate about their financial situation. When a (dying) old widow with no heirs, named Mrs. Potter , who regularly frequents the bank once a year, comes over for her annual visit, Ashley thinks quick and takes advantage of the key she left behind. She steals money from the safe deposit box and drives home nervously, afraid of being caught. She plans to return the money when she is able, without the loss being detected.  Later, after being questioned by Agent Cooper , Noel walks up to Aria's locker to ask her about being called to the principal's office. She is nonchalant about it and, in general, until she opens her locker and a book of poems falls out onto the floor. It has a note from "A"  " READ PAGE 22 -A " Which has a free verse poem written by Ezra Fitz. Noel asks her what it is, but she is so entranced by it, she doesn't care that he is suspicious and brushes him off to find a quiet spot to read the poem. She is so moved by it, she marches up to Ezra in his classroom and tells him that he is hypocritical for writing what he wrote and then denying he loves her. Ezra listens without answering much as Aria digs into him. Then, Noel appears in the doorway of Ezra's classroom and asks what's going on. Aria replies that nothing is going on and leaves Ezra fuming. Noel glowers at him before leaving, too. Ezra heaves the book across the room in frustration.  Later, Hanna is abruptly dumped from the guest list of Mona's birthday party because she ditched Mona, and also due to an alleged text sent by "A" to Mona, spreading the rumor that Hanna got liposuction to lose weight. Apparently, the rumor made its way to more than just Mona, because an overweight girl randomly approaches Hanna and asks who her doctor was. Hanna laughs it off to this stranger, but not to Mona. Mona is so upset that she even embarrasses her (former) friend in front of Naomi and Riley , as she dis-invites her from the party. Later at her party, Mona goes so far as to relish in how she treated Hanna, bringing up how she dissed Hanna in front of her friends to her party guests! At least Spencer and Emily are supportive and comfort Hanna about the falling out. Ironically, Hanna mentions Mona was her friend when the girls were no longer, and now that she's in a fight with Mona, she has them to fall back on. Can't she have both?  Meanwhile, at home , Spencer tries to mend fences with her sister, Melissa . Ian comes over to the Hastings' residence, hoping Melissa will finally give him another chance at a date over coffee. Seeing Melissa head upstairs, Spencer races after her and tells her to go for it with Ian. Melissa is persuaded, and Ian nods in her direction. They go. They walk off together to go for coffee. After they leave, Spencer confides to her friends that she had kissed Ian, and, after Melissa and Ian broke up, Spencer dated Ian for a while early last summer. The girls are understanding, unlike Alison had been. Speaking of Alison, the girls suddenly see Alison's photograph on the television screen. The report is talking about a sweater found in Alison's home with a matching blood stain. It is then revealed that the police have issued an arrest warrant for Toby Cavanaugh , who is wanted for Alison's murder . The girls are led to believe Toby was Alison's mystery boyfriend, since the sweater was identified as his.  In Emily's house , Maya comforts her friend, who is grieving over her error in judgment about Toby. To be playful, when Emily's phone rings, she has Maya answer it, not caring if it is her mother. However, the caller on the other end does not identify themselves and hangs up. Suddenly, the front door opens. Afraid, Emily calls out to see who is there, though she gets no answer. Suddenly, Emily's father , Wayne, appears in the doorway of her bedroom to surprise her; he has come home early from his tour in Afghanistan. Emily is overjoyed; she had just been telling Maya how safe he makes her feel. Then Pam appears, and her face falls a little when she sees Maya standing there. Emily makes the introductions. Pam coldly suggests that Maya should leave so that the family can have a more private reunion. Emily gently tells her that she will call her later.  At lunch with her mother, Aria discloses how much she felt that Alison hated Toby. She cannot believe how duped they were by her. Aria then looks down and sees paint stains on her mother's hands; she is happy to see her artistic side reemerge. When Ella mentions that it's due to dealing with the lies, Aria feels remorseful and asks her mother if she blames her. Ella answers that she would have preferred that Aria tell the truth, but understands she was in a very precarious position in the center of her two parents.  Back at Emily's house , Wayne asks his daughter how she's coping with the news that the boy who took her to homecoming murdered her best friend. She's obviously a little distraught. He goes on about the nobility of telling the truth while Emily's mother stands in the hallway holding the photos of Emily and Maya kissing. It appears they were mailed to Pam anonymously. Emily seems to want to tell her father about Maya , but doesn't go there; he's only been back for a few hours.  Melissa walks into Spencer's room to tell her she had a good time with Ian. They talk about their relationship and that they could be nicer to each other. That evening, the girls plan to attend the party at the Rosewood Camping Grounds, while Hanna intends to stake out the woods near the party secretly, should "A" rear their head. Aria and Spencer arrive at the party together, taking in Mona's huge stack of presents, as well as the massage and makeover tents, in addition to the lavish dessert and refreshment stands. Mona welcomes them to "Camp Mona" and hands them custom-made sweatshirts for the occasion.  Emily drives to the party separately. When she parks, Toby pops his head up from the backseat and tells a freaked-out Emily he needs to finish telling her what he started at homecoming. With the two alone in the woods, he professes his innocence and claims he met Alison the night of her death and gave her his sweater when she got cold. Ironically, he had allegedly met her to thank her for getting Jenna away from him. Then, apparently, she had joined another guy in a car, who Toby did not recognize, and the last time Toby remembers seeing Alison, she was alive. He also explains that his tattoo commemorating September 1 was celebrating his freedom from Jenna , not Alison. Emily finds out from Toby what really happened between him and Jenna; she was forcing him to have sex with her. Emily still isn't sure she believes him and says she has more questions, so he asks her to meet him at the church later, where his stuff is hidden, but Emily makes no promises. His ride is set to pick him up at midnight, and he tells Emily to keep it a secret, as her friends would surely call the cops if they knew he was back.  At the party, Emily fills the others in on Toby's confession before they start roasting marshmallows and getting their hair done in crazy 80s dos. A text from "A" sends Spencer back to the woods near the Kissing Rock , where she finds a woven bracelet with the name "Jenna" planted there. "YOU'RE AS IN THE DARK AS JENNA. LOOKING FOR ME IN ALL THE WRONG PLACES. " Hanna calls to let them know she's on her way, but their phone service is unreliable. Also, Aria gets a text from Ezra saying he needs to see her. After this, the girls get a text from " A ": " CAMP MONA'S A SCAVENGER HUNT AND I'M THE PRIZE. COME AND FIND ME, BITCHES. --A "  Ashley is in her car, driving home from the bank, when Byron spots her. He cheerfully asks for a lift, as it is on her way. However, Ashley lies, claiming she isn't headed home and abruptly declines, stating that she is late for something. She gives him a half-smile before speeding away, leaving a confused and rejected Byron behind. The situation becomes clearer when the camera zooms in on the front seat, revealing Ashley's bag, which is open because it is too full. The camera focuses on the bag's contents, showing it stuffed with wads of cash.  Later that night, the police find and arrest Toby as he waits beside the church, as if someone had tipped them off about his location.  Meanwhile, Hanna is on lookout with binoculars in the woods. She sees a car pull up, and someone gets in. She strains to see in the dark and realizes it is Mr. Fitz's car, and Aria just got into it! Ezra reconciles with Aria and apologizes. He explains he left school in order to find another job in order to make their relationship work. He asks for her forgiveness, and then the two begin kissing passionately. (Obviously, Aria's pending date with Noel is off.) They fail to notice someone writing on the car. Suddenly, a figure that Hanna assumes is the elusive "A" appears and writes "I see you" in the condensation on the back windshield. Hanna attempts to call Aria to warn her, but Aria is engrossed in a conversation with Ezra and doesn't answer her phone.  Back at the party, Spencer lets Aria know she's cracked the clue about " Wright's Playground ." She locates Emily, but not Aria, who has disappeared. At the Playground, Spencer and Emily spot a tree that has the words "Alison + Ian" carved into it with a heart drawn around it.  Hanna texts the girls, "I know who A is," and directs them to meet her in the parking lot. Hanna's discovery yields possibly fatal results because when she gets to the parking lot and spots the girls, she's quickly hit and flung over the top of an unknown car, whose driver doesn't stop to assess the damage. The girls rush to her side and call 911. A text from "A" reveals that they are responsible. " She knew too much. "  In the final scene, somewhere undisclosed, someone watches the duplicate footage of Alison at The Kissing Rock with her mystery boyfriend, wearing Toby's sweater. This time, after she says, "I know you want to kiss me," the camera turns to reveal Ian Thomas behind it. He replies, "Come closer." Are the police totally wrong about Toby?

title: Moments Later
summary: A car is seen stopping in some woods. The driver, donning a black hoodie, runs fast through the woods. Ashley is still driving home from the bank after taking the money from Mrs. Potter's account. A cop car puts on its siren, and she is forced to pull over. All Ashley can do is zip up her handbag to conceal the wads of bills in her purse. Officer Barry Maple approaches her window. Ashley smiles wanly at him; at least she knows Barry. He informs her that Hanna was involved in a car accident.  Aria , Spencer , and Emily are left unraveled after Hanna was hit by a car, presumably driven by " A ," on the night of Mona's glamping party. An unconscious Hanna is lifted on a stretcher and taken into an ambulance. Mona approaches the scene in the parking lot and is shocked to find out Hanna is the one being treated. Before Aria turns to leave with the other girls for the hospital, she makes eye contact with Noel , who is wearing a black hoodie.  The girls are at the hospital calling their parents when Hanna's mom (who is talking to Lucas) comes over to tell them Hanna has a broken leg, a broken ankle, bruised ribs, and the doctors may need to remove her spleen, but she is going to be okay. She is clutching her full handbag tightly to her frame. Ashley asks the girls what had happened, and they talk about the events of last night. Spencer accuses Toby, but much to Emily's surprise, Hanna's mom says the police picked him up last night. She sends the girls home and promises to call them when Hanna can have visitors. The girls have a brief debate over what to do and come to the grand conclusion of waiting to do anything until they can talk to Hanna because she probably knows more about the A situation. Spencer gets home, and her creepy sister is actually quite lovely and comforting, although Spencer does get a bit of a surprise in the form of a semi-dressed Ian appearing in the doorway to ask about Hanna.  The next morning, Hanna wakes up in the hospital with her mother by her side. Hanna asks about her friends. Her mom tells her the girls were there the night before, along with Sean and Lucas . Ashley is, of course, concerned by this nerdy acquaintance her daughter has made, but seems placated to hear that he's nothing more than a yearbook colleague. Hanna reaches for her hospital room phone to call the girls. Ezra shows Aria the "I SEE YOU" message written on the back of his car, and they discuss it in the middle of town in broad daylight. Ezra is very concerned that someone has seen them the night before. Aria keeps repeating that it doesn't mean anything and wipes it away with her sleeve.  Emily is eating breakfast with her dad and mother . She reveals that she and her boyfriend, Ben , broke up and tries to defend Toby , but her parents are having none of that.  The girls finally make it to the hospital to see Hanna , but first they have to get rid of Ashley so that they can talk candidly. Once Hanna manages that, she reveals what she discovered. First, she says that Noel Kahn is A because she saw him write a message on the back of a car. Emily asks what car and what he wrote. Hanna looks at Aria, and she says, 'I see you.' She explains she was in the car, which belongs to Ezra Fitz.  Aria tells the truth about her and Ezra , and the girls are shocked by Aria's involvement with a teacher. Spencer is surprised to know that Aria's affair has been going on for a while. Aria says she "didn't just get into his car last night. Who do you think I am?" Hanna explains she saw Aria go into a parked car and then witnessed Noel run up to Ezra's car while Aria was inside and write "I SEE YOU" on his windshield, without signing it from "A." Aria states it can't be Noah because they didn't see who was driving the car that hit Hanna.  There's a knock on the door, and it's Noel ! Aria tells him Hanna is sleeping and takes him into the hallway for a chat. She tells him Hanna will be okay and takes the little teddy bear gift basket he brought. Noel eyes her and ominously tells her they need to talk. She promises to call him and asks him where he was last night. He says he was with Sean. Aria walks back into Hanna's room with the teddy bear basket and says Noel lied to her because he told her he was with Sean.  Emily's parents cuddle on the couch and discuss household chores. Wayne mentions he has to go away again. Pam encourages him to talk to their poor, (sexually) confused daughter. He says Pam is doing a great job, but she looks worried, which makes him concerned about the situation.  Hanna wakes up from a bad dream and feels uneasy about the teddy bear staring at her. Soon, Mona enters the room, waving a white bra as a peace offering. She feels guilty because Hanna was hit by a car while sneaking around the edge of Mona's party. The two quickly reconnect and resume their friendship. Next, Mona pulls out some makeup to make Hanna look fabulous again. As they chat, Mona reminisces about a past event they shared and tells Hanna how much she admired her for taking a bow after puking on a trampoline during a backflip. It's the reason she wanted to be friends with her in the first place.  The rest of the girls rule out Ian as "A," since he was with Melissa the night before. The girls are discussing the A situation. Spencer states there is a good chance that Noel is A because he has the means and the opportunity to hit Hanna with the car, and the photo of Maya and Emily was stolen at his party. Aria thinks Spencer goes quickly from suspecting Toby to Noel. They conclude that Aria still has to deal with Noel about what he saw.  Hanna's door slowly creaks open, revealing Lucas , who has come to visit her. He leans over and kisses her gently on the forehead while she sleeps. After he walks away, Hanna opens her eyes, fully aware that he had kissed her, as she had been awake the whole time.  The next morning, Hanna wakes up to see Ashley standing over her. Hanna tells her mother she doesn't need a private room, since it's expensive. Hanna's mom makes up something about a temporary bank loan to placate her daughter.  Aria is tinkling away on a piano when Noel finds her so that they can have their chat. She tells him she saw him at the campground after the accident. He claims he just wanted to scare a bunch of girls in the woods. Noel admits he saw Aria in Ezra's car and doesn't deny he was the one who wrote on the car window. He offers to go to the principal with her, asking what Mr. Fitz made her do. She tells him it's not like that and makes him promise not to say anything, which he reluctantly agrees to.  Emily is trying to get an update on Toby when Jenna overhears and claims Toby doesn't want to talk to her, and she wouldn't let them talk to each other because she makes him run away. Jenna says she won't let anyone come between her and Toby anymore, and Emily mentions the incest thing to throw Jenna off a bit, and it works in incensing Jenna.  Hanna has a painkiller-induced hallucination (or is it?) – as our favorite troublemaker , donned in a candy striper outfit, drops subtle hints about her disappearance that fateful night. Hanna tries to ask her what happened, but all Alison will say is that the four of them combined already know the truth. She says she finds "A" to be a bitch and tells Hanna she needs to do something about her. She also says it was dangerous for her to come, but she did it for Hanna, worried about her being in the hospital. After she leaves, Hanna spots a Styrofoam cup near her bed with a berry-colored lipstick stain on the rim, matching the exact shade of lipstick Alison is wearing during her "visit."  Ezra enters his classroom to find Aria sitting waiting for him. They jabber a bit about how Ezra makes Aria miserable sometimes, yet he doesn't make her unhappy. Aria asks if Ezra would turn it all back if he could. He asks it back to her. They both say they wouldn't go back and decide to stay together while they stare into each other's eyes. After this, Aria meets with Emily at the lockers, who asks if she told Mr. Fitz about Noel. Aria says she couldn't.  Lucas brings Hanna vanilla, tapioca, and butterscotch pudding, but no chocolate (?). Hanna tells Lucas he's a good friend . When he doesn't take the hint, she brings up his nighttime smooch. He confirms she didn't hallucinate it; it did, in fact, happen. Lucas thinks she can do better than Sean and leaves her alone with her thoughts and her pudding.  Emily is chatting on the phone with Maya when she notices Wayne standing in her bedroom doorway, looking concerned. He has heard that she contacted the police station to talk about Toby. Emily insists that Toby hasn't done anything wrong to her. Despite her reassurance, Wayne keeps pressing her to share what's on her mind. After some insistence, she finally reveals, "I am gay." Wayne falls silent for a moment.  Spencer and Aria walk in the woods and talk about Aria's affair with Ezra. Spencer declares it to be both self-destructive and really hot. It turns out they're looking for the tree with the "Alison + Ian" carving, but it was conveniently chopped down!  Emily's parents discuss their daughter's newfound sexuality. Pam says Emily is not afraid of them but of ''this'', she shows Wayne the photo of Maya and Emily at Noel Kahn's party and tells someone sent this to her. "Someone made her this way!" "She's experimenting!" "Let's keep this in perspective." Wayne is understanding (and happy she's not on drugs or pregnant), while Pam is livid and judgmental; she thinks Emily should be who they expect her to be. All the while, Emily is sitting at the top of the stairs, listening to their conversation.  Aria and Spencer arrive at Spencer's house to talk. Ian invites them outside to drink a toast of champagne. Spencer demands that Ian explain what they are celebrating and why he canceled varsity practice that day. Ian admits he and Melissa eloped! Only Aria has the sense to utter congratulations. Spencer is in shock. Is her sister sleeping with the enemy? Ezra leaves his classroom late at night; Noel is lurking in the hallway.  The girls are contemplating the tree and the possibility of "A" and the killer being two different people when they discover an "A" message on Hanna's cast. " SORRY ABOUT LOSING MY TEMPER, MY BAD, LOVE, -A. " The girls all lose it, and Hanna shouts that they have to get it off her.  The episode ends with someone burning the part of the tree with the "Alison + Ian" carving. Is that Spencer's family's cabin house ?

title: Salt Meets Wound
summary: The girls wheel their helpless friend Hanna back into her home (kitchen), where she'll be on bed rest for a few more days before returning to school . They discuss the fact that A got into her hospital room when they wrote on her cast. She asks Aria if she has already figured out if Noel Kahn is A, but Aria says she is avoiding him. The other girls leave to get the rest of her belongings. While attempting to reach something on a high shelf, she knocks some boxes down and discovers the wads of cash in a lasagna box that Ashley hid from her mini-heist. The girls return; Hanna gets rid of them so she can be alone with the stack of money. She's not too alone, though, because she gets a text from " A !"  " Like Mommy, like daughter. Can you run from the law on those legs? --A. " A little while later, Ashley is home with her new purchases for Hanna. Hanna confronts her mom about the money, which she plays off as an "unauthorized loan." Ashley insists that it's her problem and that Hanna should worry about getting better. Over at Emily's house , an awkward family breakfast is underway. Emily convinces her parents to have Maya over for dinner and meet the girl who‘s won her heart in the hopes of melting Pam's . Pam gives in and checks if Maya has any allergies.  Spencer makes out with her blue-collar beau, Alex , until her mom shows up with coffee. Spencer expresses her surprise at the fact that her parents aren't more upset about Melissa's elopement, but her mom says it is outrageous, but "what's done is done," and reminds Spencer that she was a big part of making her sister's life difficult the past few months. They see Toby walking into the church, Spencer asks why Toby is out of Jail, Veronica tells her that he is out on bail.  Emily tells Maya to wear a dress for dinner and mentions that her parents have been acting strangely since she came out. Humorously, she points out "changing the channel when Ellen comes on" as an example.  English class ends, but Aria stays for a bit of extra help. She tells Ezra that Noel left the message on his car, but claims he has known about them for a while, and would have said something by now if he was going to. Ezra doesn't want to discuss this at school, so Aria invites herself over to his place later.  Mona , feeling guilty for dumping Hanna the night she was hit, decides to throw her a surprise welcome home party. At school, Mona stops Emily and Spencer in the hallway to invite them to Hanna's place for the party that night. They're a bit skeptical, but Mona mentions Hanna is up for it. Meanwhile, Noel approaches Mr. Fitz with his harshly graded paper and gives him a bunch of pointed stares and veiled threats. Mr. Fitz does not go along with the threats and says the paper is worth a C. Noel crosses out the 'C' and writes a clear 'A' on the paper.  Ezra stares wistfully out of his classroom window when Aria approaches. Ezra tells her about Noel's request earlier, and Aria grabs his hand until they're interrupted by Jenna . She needs his signature on her absence card, and she's sorry she interrupted.  Meanwhile, Spencer's relationship with Alex is going well. Alex was invited to a tennis summit in Sweden, which could lead to a professional tennis career, but it turns out he had promised his uncle he would work for him that summer. Spencer doesn't understand how he could prefer hard labor to playing tennis, but ultimately accepts his decision.  Over at Emily's coming-out dinner, Maya reveals she can't eat the seafood Pam has so lovingly prepared because she's allergic to seafood. Pam is surprised to learn this since she had "specifically asked" Emily, who says she "forgot." Emily's father is won over, but Pam finds Maya's story about her mother's tattoo crass and doesn't fail to mention to Emily that she sees their whole relationship as crude, ruining an otherwise lovely time for Emily. To make matters worse, when Pam sees Emily playing footsie, she quietly runs off to cry in the pantry.  Unfortunately, Hanna is clueless about the homecoming party Mona is throwing for her, and it doesn't turn out well. Not only does Noel show up, but Lucas drinks too much. Just the sight of Noel prompts Hanna to have a flashback about him at a different party, when Alison manipulated a girl to dump Noel so Aria could have him. Hanna tries to talk to Lucas, but he's too busy pounding alcohol to put up with her niceties. Back at Emily's, she and Maya kiss goodbye on the porch when Pam awkwardly interrupts with leftovers. Maya thinks it is really sweet of Pam and hugs her.  Spencer and Alex are having a cute chat about a getaway weekend and have a kiss, which Spencer breaks off because she sees Noel. When Alex asks what is wrong, she says, 'Nothing, it is just busy here.' They agree to go outside after Spencer goes to use the bathroom. Noel sees Aria enter and tries to make small talk when she accuses him of blackmailing Ezra for a higher grade. Noel denies it and tells Aria it's all in Mr. Fitz's head.  Elsewhere in Rosewood , Toby was released from jail and is out on bail due to insufficient evidence, but with one caveat: an ankle monitor, keeping him all too close to step-sister Jenna. Emily sees Toby sitting on his stoop wearing his house arrest anklet and heads over to tell him she wasn't the one who turned him in to the cops.  Aria tells Hanna that she wants to leave, and Hanna jokes about hot faculty parties. Hanna mentions that Aria should have told them about her relationship with Ezra much sooner, since they tell each other everything.  Spencer finds Alex outside; he's all upset. Apparently, someone submitted his application for the Swedish tennis summit. He accuses Spencer of lying when she denies that she wasn't okay with Alex's decision to work instead. Since she was the only one he told about the summit, he assumes it could not have been anyone else's doing. He then walks outs on her at Hanna's homecoming party. After he leaves, our suspicions are confirmed when Spencer gets a text from "A": " Point, set, match! -xo A. " Taking credit for their breakup.  Hanna and Sean are telling a story about skiing when Lucas interrupts to pick a fight with Sean by calling him a Saint Bernard. Lucas is clearly still upset about Hanna rejecting him and makes a big scene. When Sean finally gets mad, Noel hilariously stops him by declaring, "It's like fighting a kid that needs a telethon!" Hanna requests an audience with Lucas outside. She tells him not to pick a fight with Sean when he's really mad at her. Lucas says not everything is about her. He goes off on a rant, which ends with him revealing he destroyed Alison's memorial since she was such a bitch to him for so long. Hanna tells him she'll keep it between them, but that makes him sadder because when she's nice to him, it makes him like her more. Hanna brings up her suspicious feelings about Noel to Sean, who wants to party. Hanna's not really in the party mood, though, and she asks Sean if he wants to send everyone home. Later, Spencer tells Aria what happened with Alex, and Spencer mentions Noel as being A. Aria continues to say they are not sure Noel is A. What do they actually want from them, and what can they do about it? Then they are interrupted by Noel, who wants to pass them to use the bathroom.  Later, Jenna joins Toby on the stoop to reveal that, in a controlling mood, she was the person who turned him in to the cops to keep him close. She tries to kiss him, and he rejects her, so she angrily slaps him.  Hanna is alone at her house, cleaning up after the party she didn't even throw, when she hears creepy noises from upstairs. She wheels around with one of her crutches, then hides in the kitchen in the dark. Just when she's starting to freak out, her mom comes home and asks what happened. When she hears that people were over, she promptly heads to the pasta box to find that their money has been stolen.  Emily gets home and is sad to hear from Pam that Wayne has to leave sooner than expected. She is, however, grateful that Pam is okay with her sexual orientation, until she reveals that she is not okay with it. In fact, it makes her sick to her stomach.  Over at their house, Spencer and her dad make small talk about how sketchy Ian is and how the cops are ready to put Toby away because the blood on his sweater is a match with Alison's blood. Spencer sees a "Hilton Head" tag for a country club on Ian's golf bag and has a flashback of Alison returning from an alleged summer with her grandma in Georgia and with the same tag on her luggage from South Carolina. Spencer questioned Ali about it, but she evaded the questions, turning it around on Spencer like she'd always done.  Hanna and her mom are saddened by the fact that their stolen money was stolen. Hanna shares her sleeping pills with her mother as a condolence prize. Once she's alone, Hanna finds a note from "A" in one of her pill boxes: "YOU'LL GET YOUR $$$ BACK. IF YOU DO WHAT I SAY. SWEET DREAMS -A. " Promising to give the money back if she does what A says. We then watch "A" slipping the hundred-dollar bills into a creepy clown piggy bank.

title: Know Your Frenemies
summary: Spencer sneaks downstairs while Melissa and Ian whisper ominously about something (not audible). A stair creaks as she tries to get closer; she runs back upstairs. Melissa investigates to see if anyone is listening. Ian insists that no one could have heard them, but they look concerned. Spencer sneaks back into her room to find a message from " A " saying: Married for love or an Alibi? - A.  The next morning, Spencer sneaks downstairs again. She attempts to make some coffee, but of course, Ian appears. He asks if they woke her up last night, but she lies, saying she didn't even know they were back. He mentions that he and Melissa will be moving out, and claims he and Spencer are now family and so she has to start looking at him like that. Spencer then spots a resort tag from Hilton Head attached to Ian's luggage; she starts quizzing him about his visit. He claims it was a while back. The tag is from the same country club Alison visited while supposedly visiting her grandmother the weekend of her disappearance . In a flashback, we see Spencer always doubted the veracity of Ali's story about going to the country club with her grandmother, since it was in South Carolina, her grandmother lived in Georgia, and "Ali hated old people."  At the Montgomerys' place , Aria's dad made breakfast for Aria and her brother . He then reveals that their mother is dating other people. Mike does not take this news well, and he walks away angry.  Meanwhile, Spencer calls up Hilton Head to try to get some info about Ian. She tells Emily about her suspicions that Ali was with Ian at Hilton Head right before she died. Emily is skeptical about what motivations Ian would have to kill Alison . The subject changes to Toby , whom Spencer still does not trust completely and accuses of being a liar. However, Emily forces Spencer to acknowledge the fact that Alison, Toby, the girls, and practically everyone else on this show lie like crazy. Just then, Agent Cooper passes by and bids them good morning.  As Ashley drops Hanna off at The Grille , Hanna brings up her guilt over losing the money. Her mom says she already paid off their debt, but now she can't invest the rest to earn enough to pay it all back. Then her mom insists that "it's only a felony if they find out." Hanna gets out of the car and then joins Emily and Spencer. Agent Cooper is still standing at their table, and she informs the girls that there's a solid case against Toby, so if they don't need her for anything else, she's planning her leave out of Rosewood. They tell her no before Spencer finds out Ian was at Hilton Head the same weekend as Ali. At Rosewood High , the girls are talking about the new information they have gathered about Ian, his stay at Hilton Head with Ali, the tree with his and Ali's names engraved in it, and the fact that the tree disappeared. The girls continue to suspect Noel , who chats up Mike to Aria's surprise. Maya comes over. She and Emily discuss their plans for studying later, despite Pam's attitude about them being together. The rest of the girls giggle their approval -in support of Emily's newly gay status.  Noel continues to attempt to blackmail Mr. Fitz into giving him an A on his paper. Ezra refuses until another student comes in and asks Noel if he is still dating Aria. Noel makes an ominous remark about Aria liking older guys, so that it didn't work out between them.  Hanna finds a note attached to a Benjamin Franklin bill in her locker, instructing her to go to 21 Main St. and ask for Hefty Hanna's order, signed "A." When Aria arrives, Hanna quickly hides the money and lies about having physical therapy to avoid grabbing coffee with her after school. Meanwhile, Emily shares that Toby is back at school. As Toby retrieves his books from his locker, he sees the word "KILLER" scrawled on it. He is escorted through the hallways by security, with students giving him judgmental glances. One student even confronts him directly, accusing him of being a murderer. Hanna walks out of Lucky Leons Cupcakes with a cupcake box when she receives another message saying: Want the Money? Sit there and eat, everyone-A . She sees Noel getting out of a car and walking towards a group of boys who are standing outside the cupcake shop. Hanna opens the box, and inside we see a half-dozen cupcakes, cruelly decorated like piglets. In the next shot, we see Hanna eating all the cupcakes when a group of three boys is making nasty comments to her. She has flashbacks to her heavier days while "A" forces her to eat in public to earn back more of her mom's stolen money; she recalls the time Alison gave her advice to purge after binges to drop the pounds. She eats, as jocks from school, including Noel, look on and taunt her. Hanna sees this as proof of Noel's identity as "A."  At the Fields' home , Emily and Maya are giggling in her room when her judgmental mom sees their bare legs through the partially open door. She busts in, scandalized, as if they were doing much more than just studying. Maya tells Pam they were studying, to which Pam reacts that Maya should call her Mrs. Fields. Maya senses she should go and heads out, while Emily tells her mother she is ashamed to be her daughter. After Hanna finishes the cupcakes, she receives a text from "A" saying ''You know how to get rid of it. --A'' , presumably taunting her to purge the cupcakes. Just then, Aria spots her and comes over, capably getting rid of the athletes, who are still oinking at her. Aria asks Hanna why she lied about physical therapy, and asks if Hanna wants to talk about it. Hanna gets emotional, and Aria lovingly wipes cupcake remains from Hanna's face. Then Hanna says that she hates A while looking at Noel. Hanna tells what A made her do to help her mother, and she confesses about the bulimia and Alison's advice. After her heart-to-heart conversation with Aria, Hanna goes to the bathroom, but not to take "A" up on the second part of her dare; instead, she goes to wash her hands and reaches for the paper towels. The first one reads "Oink, Oink -A" followed by two towels with three-hundred-dollar bills, also courtesy of "A."  Maya forgot her backpack at Emily's place, which Pam discovers. She invades Maya's privacy and finds drugs hidden in a breath mint tin. Noel walks into Mr. Fitz's classroom, asking if he took another look at his paper. Mr. Fitz gives the paper back to Noel with a big red C written on it, saying it is the grade he earned. Noel aggressively asks if he knows what this means. Meanwhile, Spencer is out for a run when she sees Toby across the street and crouches down next to a car to watch the townsfolk be mean and judge him. After some little kids run away from him, truly frightened, he runs into an alley to cry, and Spencer seems to pity him for once. Pam walks into Emily's room , saying they need to talk. She tells Emily that Maya left her backpack and that she gave it back to Maya's parents. Then she asks Emily if she is doing drugs with Maya, to which Emily, shocked, denies. They discuss whether it would be different if Emily were dating a boy, to which Pam says she doesn't know who Emily is anymore and that Emily isn't allowed to see Maya anymore. But this doesn't change the way Emily feels about her. Aria grows increasingly suspicious of Mike 's burgeoning friendship with Noel, especially when Mike tells Byron and Aria at the dinner table, somewhat unwittingly, that Noel has been spreading a rumor about Mr. Fitz being with one of his students. Byron reacts scoldingly, knowing all too well how an illicit relationship with a student can permanently ruin one's teaching career. Mike assures him it's true. Noel saw them and will tell the principal tomorrow. Aria, flustered, makes up some excuse about studying with Spencer and runs out to her car. Of course, Aria ends up at Ezra's , where he tells her the lying and sneaking around is over. Apparently, their relationship is the "most real and honest thing" in his life. Ezra has decided to resign and leave Rosewood so that Noel has no reason to tell on them. Seemingly, Noel has made him feel like what he's doing is wrong, and he doesn't want to feel like that. Aria tells him she loves him, and they kiss passionately. Meanwhile, Spencer actually is studying like Aria said they would. She gets distracted by Ian 's boxes and starts to open one when Melissa gets home. Spencer has to dive back into her books nonchalantly. Melissa drops something; Spencer picks it up to discover an ovulation kit. Melissa asks if Spencer can keep a secret from their parents, then says she's trying to get pregnant. In her shock, Spencer hilariously asks, "With IAN?!" Melissa rolls her eyes. Spencer wants to know what the rush is, since Melissa has always been career-driven and has never mentioned babies before. Melissa then says, "I don't feel like I need to be the best and the first anymore. All those things that used to matter... don't seem that important." Spencer is concerned that her super-driven sister has been married for all of three days and has done a complete 180 personality-wise. Melissa reassures Spencer that she is pleased. Ian walks in, surprised that Melissa has revealed their secret to Spencer. Melissa insists that Spencer can keep a secret, and Ian gives her a pointed look and says he knows she can. At home , Hanna tries to sneak her hard-earned cash back into the lasagna box, but her mom walks in and busts her. Hanna claims she found it in the bathroom at the cupcake place. Ashley is skeptical, but is not going to complain about the influx of cash. Hanna's mom also refuses to reveal how she can tell when Hanna is lying, so Hanna stands in front of the mirror and declares she is a virgin, then says she isn't a virgin, hoping to catch the difference in her demeanor.  Aria calls her father to lie that she's sleeping over at Spencer's. She and Ezra cuddle by candlelight, instead, hoping it's not the last night they can be together.  Spencer has already spilled the beans about Melissa 's impending pregnancy to Hanna. Spencer voices her suspicion about Melissa's sudden decision to have children. Emily comes over and reveals Maya is being shipped off to juvie camp for three months because of the joint Pam found.  Ezra is getting ready to resign when security breaks into Noel 's locker and finds stolen exam answers. Mr. Fitz and all four girls witness this. As Noel is being escorted out of the school, the girls get a text from A, saying ' 'A is for Alison, not Amateur'' , basically taking credit for the bust.  The girls are at Spencer's house . Aria is all smiles because "A" saved her and Ezra's relationship. Hanna reminds Aria that "A" also tried to run her down, but as long as Ezra gets to stay in town, she's happy. Melissa comes in and makes some pleasantries with the girls, which ends in her telling the girls she doesn't have to worry about Ian looking at other women. Then, the girls surprise Emily by sneaking her away for one last romantic night with Maya in Spencer's room –with lit candles and plenty of privacy.  The rest of the girls go through Ian 's boxes downstairs while Emily and Maya have a bittersweet farewell dance upstairs. The girls downstairs accomplish nothing. Maya thanks them and hugs everyone goodbye while someone watches from the window. After she's gone, Emily thanks them and tells the girls Maya is going to a place called True North. Hanna mentions another girl who went where Maya is heading, for huffing spray paint, and came back as a drummer in a gospel band. They then receive another text: ''Don't say I never gave you anything. Turn on your computer.'' -A. Spencer opens her laptop, and they see a shocking video about the night Alison disappeared. It's the duplicate footage Officer Cooper showed them, but there's extra footage in this video: seconds of footage center on a smiling Ian. Then the camera angle shifts, and we hear Allison moaning. Alison's hand with her name bracelet comes into the view of the lens, groping the leaves on the ground, as she seems to have fallen, until the hand stops moving and goes limp. The girls scream as they see this, and then they hear a noise outside. Whoever it was runs through the woods as the girls try to chase their stalker, but they are gone by the time they're outside. Melissa and Ian are whispering in the downstairs of Spencer's house.

title: Careful What U Wish 4
summary: The girls examine the video " A " left for them that illuminates what looks to be the final moments of Alison's life near the Kissing Rock the night she disappeared . Right after Ian's cameo on the video, he surprises them in person, as he tries to grab a late-night snack from the Hastings' kitchen. The girls all freak out while Ian makes small talk, acting nonchalant, so there's no indication whether he saw his face on the computer screen or not. After he leaves, they decide they need to hand the video over to the police.  At school , the girls are decorating for the school's upcoming dance-a-thon, but take a break to discuss whether or not they should turn the video in to the police. They question "A's" motives, but Emily doesn't care; as far as she's concerned, she doesn't want Toby to go to jail, and this video could prevent that. Aria agrees with Emily and offers to drive Spencer to the police station during their lunch break.  Later, Hanna tries to get a job to alleviate the Marins' financial strife. She asks Sean if she can work for his mother as a dental assistant again, but Sean says no, because last time she threatened a kid with a drill bit after he aimed his spit at her. Sean is suspicious of why she needs money and can't get it from her mother, so she makes up an excuse about wanting to save up for some expensive earrings.  Next, Ella meets up with Aria in the gymnasium, bringing along Simone , who used to be Aria's babysitter and is now her role model, a "published author" living in New York City. Just like Aria's dream future! Aria's mom invited Simone to speak to her English class and ran over to Ezra to offer him Simone's services, in more ways than one. Simone offers Aria some career advice. Ella returns to tell Simone she'll be speaking to Ezra's class and will then be meeting him for a coffee date. Aria is predictably awkward about the whole thing.  We then see Emily on the phone, arguing with Maya's guards at her rehab center, True North. The guards won't allow her to speak to her girlfriend. Apparently, she can only receive calls from her mother and father. So, Hanna offers up the phone-hacking services of a new kid with tech cred, who can wire Emily's phone to make it seem that she is one of the St. Germains when she calls Maya.  At lunch, the girls are getting ready to head to the police station when they realize Spencer's laptop is missing, even though it's been in her bag, plastered to her side all day, except when she had it in her gym locker during P.E.  A notebook was swapped with her laptop to camouflage the weight difference. The girls deduce it must have been taken when she left it in her gym locker, which Ian has access to since he is an athletic coach. Emily walks up to Caleb , the new kid who is helping her with her phone. She asks him if her phone is ready. He nervously looks around and tells her that he doesn't do deadlines. She offers him 40 dollars more, and he accepts, but wants to be discreet. So they walk together, talking about Maya and her situation at True North. Hanna tries to get a job with a local store clerk, who is also a family friend, and finds out just how strapped their situation is when the woman lets her know that her mother owes their store a lot of money. Hanna offers to pay off the debt, but the woman says that Hanna alone couldn't pay off the debt, "there are not enough days in the week." An irritated Hanna gets into Sean's car; he doesn't understand what the big deal is and why she can't just ask your mom for a bigger allowance. Just then, "A" sends Hanna a text saying: ''Wanna keep Mommy out of prison? I've got a job for you. --A. Aria shows up at Ezra's unannounced with coffee. It turns out he was reading one of Simone's short stories before meeting with her for coffee. Aria gets jealous, but Ezra points out that her mother was being persistent, and he could tell her he is seeing someone. Ezra is ready to leave, but in a desperate move, Aria offers to stay to read and clean out the refrigerator, but he turns her down, telling her to go. He kisses her, and they leave separately (50 seconds apart) as a precaution not to be seen.  Next, Ian is in the Hastings' kitchen making himself a sandwich when Spencer comes in to ask him if he's seen her laptop. He claims he hasn't seen it and tells Spencer he'll be at the dance that night, having been asked to chaperone. Then he makes cryptic comments about people gossiping in a small town. When she inquires about it, he says they're living under the same roof and they should try to be a family.  That night, Spencer and Hanna wait in the coat check line at the dance; Hanna shows off her hip flask. Meanwhile, Emily watches Ian lock his suspicious briefcase away in his desk drawer. Ian checks his coat with his keys in the pocket. The girls begin to hatch a plan to get the keys and get into his desk, where they think Spencer's laptop is clearly hidden. Hanna wonders if he already erased the video. Spencer says that if he did, it would indicate definite guilt and that they should inform the police.  It turns out Aria 's parents are both chaperoning the dance as well; they exchange awkward pleasantries. Meanwhile, Simone wanders over to Aria and jokingly begs her not to request a Backstreet Boys song. She explains she has come to see Ezra because they had a good time; Simone can sense Aria might not want her there.  Caleb shows up with Emily's newly souped-up phone, and Hanna calls him out for overcharging poor Emily. They exchange words about not knowing the first thing about Hanna, and he leaves. Hanna then gets a text from "A" telling: ''Job description: Heartbreaker. $200 for each dance with Lucas. --A''.  Hanna is dancing with Sean , but tells him she should dance with poor, lonely Lucas , who reminds her so much of herself in her own dork days. Sean is not happy and claims Hanna was different than Lucas because she was sweet, while Lucas seems deserving of a beating. He then tells her that if she wants to perform charity, she should save a whale. But Sean leaves, and Hanna convinces Lucas to dance with her.  Outside, Emily finishes up a conversation with Maya , sounding a bit disappointed. Spencer asks her what's wrong, and Emily says Maya sounded absent, like she was there but wasn't. Spencer tries to soften it, but Emily concludes Maya has probably moved on.  Meanwhile, Ezra is chatting with Simone about Prague and absinthe and other adult subjects. They discuss their previous travels in Europe. Aria, totally jealous of how much the two have in common, interrupts their conversation and is promptly embarrassed when her former babysitter brings up her stuffed Cookie Monster from childhood.  Ezra is guarding the garderobe, so she asks him if she can have number 62 because her dad left something in the pocket, and he gives the jacket to her. Aria then retrieves Ian's keys from his coat and leaves, passing them along to Spencer. Meanwhile, Hanna convinces Lucas to dance with her for just one more song, which happens to be a slow one, and he grows hopeful of Hanna's newfound interest in him.  Aria makes some comments to her mother about Simone and Ezra , but luckily, her mom gets the wrong idea and thinks Aria is jealous that Simone is going after Ezra instead of spending time with her. Her mom unwittingly comments on how it's hard to find the right guy, and sometimes, you have to go for it. She pats her on the head and says Someday she'll understand.  Hanna then leaves Lucas on the dance floor when an angered Sean confronts Hanna about the fact that "one dance" with Lucas has turned into five. Sean is unforgiving of Hanna's unceremonious treatment of him and asks Hanna if she brought him to the dance to diss him. Hanna then gets a text, Sean angrily says, 'Don't answer that,' but Hanna replies that it is important, on Sean walks away. The text is from "A" saying Want a raise? $500 for every dance with Lucas.'' --A. Any chance of Hanna dancing with Sean again that night, or possibly ever again, is now gone. She returns for another dance with Lucas, discreetly crying on his shoulder as they sway. Meanwhile, Spencer uses the swiped keys to break into Ian 's office. As she's trying to crack his locked desk drawers, bad boy Caleb inauspiciously shows up as she does so, and laughingly asks if she needs help breaking into the desk. Spencer asks Caleb to close the door and come in to but he defiantly opens the door further. He then makes comments about the rich, pretty, and smart girls, to which Spencer asks him how much it costs to keep this secret.  Back on the dance floor, Byron brings his estranged wife a drink, and their song starts playing, so they decide to dance. He tries to convince her that they should take Simone and the kids out for dinner, but she shoots down his proposal, not wanting to complicate their tenuous relationship. After this scene, we see Emily taking Hanna's flask from her bag in the garderobe, searching for something to forget her conversation with Maya  Later, Aria and Spencer are dancing, Spencer says that none of the keys worked, Aria asks what Caleb has seen, and if Spencer had to pay him off. Still, she replies that he didn't want to take any money, but she suspects he won't tell anything. Then Aria sees Ezra and Simone together again, this time on the dance floor, and jealousy takes over. She marches up to them and demands, "We have to talk." Spencer sees what's happening and intervenes, asking Mr. Fitz to dance, giving Aria a chance to cool off. Simone jokes to Aria that Spencer must have a crush on her English teacher  Meanwhile, after her terse call with Maya , Emily finds herself drinking from Hanna's stolen hip flask. Hanna finds her. Emily asks why Hanna is dancing with Lucas, torturing him. Emily compares Hanna to Alison, who also felt powerful in situations like this. Then Hanna receives another text: ''You have Lucas' heart. Now rip it out. Last dance $1000. --A''. Spencer is finally done dancing with Ezra , on Aria asks her what that was all about. Spencer says to Aria that it was about saving her relationship because she was going to ruin it, and she knows it all too well. In the next shot, Sean walks towards Hanna, apologizing and asking her to dance. Hanna rejects because she has to dance with Lucas, but she can't tell why. Sean says she can be with him too and breaks up with Hanna, saying We're over.'' Lucas walks up to Hanna, asking if she is okay. She says dance with me and they have yet another dance. Aria and Spencer are taking care of a drunk Emily, who is ranting about Ian and how Toby is sitting at home with an anklet monitor. She then nearly causes an accusatory scene with Ian about his murdering Alison. Ian holds up Spencer and says they are going to dance. He then asks what Emily was talking about. Spencer covers all this up, claiming Emily's accusation was referring to her and Ian's kiss last summer, but this too angers Ian, who had hoped nobody else knew that damning secret. Spencer and Hanna get the still-wasted Emily outside and decide they'll all crash at Spencer's that night, so Emily doesn't have to deal with her mother, and Spencer doesn't have to be alone with Ian lurking about. Lucas approaches Hanna and offers her a ride home. Now that it seems finished between Hanna and Sean , Lucas feels he has a chance with her. But Hanna insists her friends need her. After Lucas walks off, Hanna finds that "A" did not disappoint; she pulls her scarf out of her coat pocket, and a fat wad of cash falls out onto the ground.  Outside, in the parking lot, Aria tells Ezra he would be better off with Simone , who is smart, pretty, and accomplished, and sheds a tear. Ezra replies, saying he's in love with someone else already (Aria). He moves in to kiss her, but backs up, knowing anybody could see them in the school parking lot.  At Spencer's home , Hanna prevents Emily from drunk-dialing Maya and puts her to bed. Emily starts to apologize, but Hanna says she was right, and Hanna feels bad for leading Lucas on so insensitively. But Emily falls asleep, missing Hanna's admission. Hanna removes Emily's shoes and pulls the covers over her.  When she goes downstairs, Hanna discovers Spencer's laptop has reappeared on the coffee table under some newspaper with the incriminating video erased and a photo of Alison the night she disappeared in its stead. There's a message courtesy of "A" saying: Watch your backs. I didn't. --A''. The picture shows Alison walking through Spencer's backyard, with a shadow in tow; it has been photographed from the perspective of the DiLaurentis house. Hanna notices the shadow behind Alison and asks Spencer if she knows who it is. Spencer claims not to know, despite looking like she does.  The episode ends with Ella working the coat check at the end of the night. She returns a black jacket and a pair of black leather gloves to someone with the number 32, smiling sweetly as she bids this person good night.

title: If At First You Don't Succeed, Lie, Lie Again
summary: Aria rouses the girls early in the morning from their sleep at Spencer's house . She's been up all night analyzing the picture " A " left them. The girls all huddle close to Aria, but Spencer stands aloof, not quite comfortable participating for some reason. Aria figured out the picture was taken from the perspective of Alison's bedroom window. She thinks Alison's brother, Jason , may have taken the photo.
