Emily is disappointed in Paige as she still doesn't want to be seen alone in public with her. Paige promises she's trying by telling Emily she looked up ways to come out to her family and is getting in touch with local support groups. Emily is very supportive and offers to go along with Paige to meet with a local Pride group member.  Aria meets up with Ezra at school to discuss their plans for the upcoming Founder's Day Festival. At that moment, she spots her mother, Ella, approaching. To divert attention, Aria intentionally knocks the coffee out of Ezra's hand. As she bends down to clean up the mess, she discreetly whispers an invitation to Ezra for a quiet weekend together instead of going to the festival. However, he does not give a definitive answer.  Hanna approaches Caleb , where he's sitting reading at an outdoor bench. Caleb is hopeful this means that they're on speaking terms again when Hanna asks to sit next to him. However, she confronts Caleb for playing her and demands to know what he was supposed to be looking for. Caleb reveals Jenna wanted him to look for a key; Hanna has no clue why or to what. Caleb explains it was related to Alison. Caleb asks Hanna why Jenna is so interested, but Hanna cuts him off, not allowing him to be the one asking questions. After she exhausts everything Caleb knows, he brings up their relationship- sincerely apologizing again. Hanna nods for a moment before shrugging and strutting away.  Later, Aria lets herself into Ezra's apartment via a key under his doormat while she is on the phone with Spender. Ezra is not there, but told her to go ahead and order takeout. In the meantime, Aria sits herself down at his desk looking for menus when she accidentally awakens his open laptop. As the screen turns on, it displays Ezra's online social network page. On it, Aria sees a tagged picture of Ezra embracing a woman sporting a diamond ring on Ezra's website profile. Aria clicks on the image to enlarge it and learns that this woman's name is Jackie Molina . Ezra calls Aria from school to see how she's doing; Aria responds that she can't stay, without revealing what's bothering her.  In Emily's room , the girls congregate to discuss what Jenna may have been looking for. They also discuss the creep factor in Caleb rifling through Hanna's belongings, invading her privacy. But Aria comes to Caleb's defense, knowing how tempting it is sometimes to go through somebody else's information, such as her boyfriend's web page. Emily suggests coming clean to Ezra about it. Still, Hanna tries to convince Aria to create a page of her own posing as one of Jackie's past classmates to sneakily find out more about the status of her involvement with Ezra.  Spencer goes to Toby , who is fixing his motorcycle. Toby knows Spencer is innocent, but when he sees a cop car pull up closely, he suggests that she leave and offers to visit her at her home later. He picks up on the fact that her parents would rather he not come around, though. So, they agreed to meet up at the festival at 7 PM instead. Jenna comes out of the house and calls to Toby to drive her to school. It's unclear whether she overheard their date plans. Meanwhile, the officer in the car is shown to be Officer Garrett Reynolds . He opens the car door and calls out to Spencer, but she is snarly towards him and accuses him of being a traitor and something of a stalker. In defense, Garrett says that being trailed will clear Spencer's name and better him who knows her better than anyone else.  Later, Emily goes to the Grille for Paige's meeting with a Sheridan Prep Pride Group representative, but Paige stood them up. Emily stays and meets with Samara , the girl from the support group, alone. Samara and Emily make a connection, discussing what it was like at first when each came out. Samara isn't upset that Paige stood her up, as she's in the neighborhood anyway for the Rosewood Founder's Festival to set up a jewelry booth. Meanwhile, Hanna coaches Aria on how to set up a fake profile and get Jackie to accept her friend request.  At the festival, Spencer and Ian continue to play a mental chess game with each other. They set up cupcakes for the booth, while chatty Mrs. Ackard brings up Hilton Resorts in South Carolina. Spencer uses the opportunity to catch Ian in a lie. Melissa mistakenly mentions that the room she stayed in overlooked the ocean, while Mrs. Ackard explains that the particular room overlooks the golf course. Melissa gets flustered, trying to cover up her mistake. It becomes apparent that Melissa and Ian stayed in separate rooms during their fateful stay there. When Mrs. Ackard is out of earshot, Spencer asks Melissa whether she informed the police that they had stayed at different sides of the hotel. Melissa walks away, annoyed with Spencer.  At Samara 's jewelry booth, Paige gets jealous when she observes Emily with Samara, trying on earrings. Samara gives Emily the earrings for free. When Paige arrives, Samara lets her know she can always reschedule to talk about her father. Paige doesn't apologize for standing Samara up and isn't interested in telling Emily how hot she looks in the earrings, at Samara's suggestion, as she feels suddenly exposed.  Meanwhile, Caleb tries to give Hanna a special goodbye letter before he leaves town, explaining his feelings for her and, of course, apologizing. He goes to the Marins' residence to drop off the note for Hanna, but Hanna has already left to work a booth at the Founder's Day Festival with Mona . Ashley suggests Caleb deliver the note personally and say goodbye correctly - she is all too familiar with men who leave Hanna's life without saying goodbye. The encounter with Mrs. Marin allows Caleb to explain himself and winds up softening her opinion of him.  Back at the festival, Paige scolds Emily for having wrongfully exposed her secret. Paige is even rude to Samara , telling her she doesn't want to join a club, never thanking her for coming. But Samara is patient with her. Emily, on the other hand, gets completely fed up with Paige's fickle attitude and tells her it's over between them as she can't deal with her twists and turns and being Paige's secret. She thanks Samara and tells her it was nice meeting her friends before leaving them. In her room , Aria checks her computer to see that Jackie Molina accepted her friend request. But, thinking better of it, she de-friends her and closes her computer.  Following Ashley's advice, Caleb seeks Hanna out at the festival. When Hanna sees him, though, she ducks into another tent, wishing to avoid her heartbreaker—Caleb commissions Mona, who treats him unpleasantly, to deliver the letter to Hanna. Unfortunately, Mona intervenes by promising to give it, but instead she reads the letter then tears it up, drops it in the trash can, and dumps a drink on it. (The last line on the letter reads, "I love you, Hanna.")  Later at the festival, Ian corners Spencer and lets her know she'd better be careful because she's sinking fast. Spencer purses her lips at him.  Going with Emily's advice instead, Aria rents a number of wedding-themed DVDs to watch with Ezra. Ezra picks up on the hint, and Aria uses it as a conversation starter to confront Ezra about his past mysterious fiancée. Ezra comes clean to her, confessing to having almost married this woman until she broke it off. However, he assures Aria he has no second thoughts about her and doesn't think about Jackie while he's with her.  At the Founder's Day Festival, Ashley approaches Hanna to ask whether she's seen Caleb , but Hanna hasn't seen him. Ashley lets her know Caleb came over to say goodbye because he's leaving Rosewood. Then she says her opinion on Caleb has changed because she sees herself in him now.  Back home in her room, Emily is looking at the earrings she got from Samara when she gets two texts: one from Paige , which she ignores, and one from "A," which is not as easy to forget, teasing her about her past feelings for Alison . This prompts Emily to have a flashback to when Alison gave her a snow globe the summer of her disappearance. Alison alluded to the fact that it was more special than one would realize at first. She also told Emily not to tell the others because she didn't get them any presents. This flashback prompts Emily to examine the object. At the bottom, she finds a key with numbers printed on it. There's also a tag attached with the name of a storage place.  Back at his apartment , Ezra fell asleep during one of the flicks. Aria wakes him up to put on a pair of brown paper bag masks that she fashioned in order for them to take a picture together without revealing their identities. He plays along, and the two playfully don the masks. Suddenly, Aria gets a text from Emily letting her know she's found the key. Aria reports she has to leave and heads to Emily straight away. Outside Ezra's door, Garrett Reynolds turns a corner, possibly having seen Aria exit the apartment.  Back at the festival, things turn dangerous for Spencer . A text feigning to be from Toby directs her to enter the haunted house - a move Spencer would not have made otherwise. There, Spencer finds a creepy message scrawled by A on the walls, warning her to shut up. She immediately looks for an exit and mistakenly enters a grate, where someone uses a crowbar to trap her inside. Spencer panics, banging on the walls, shouting for help; the service on her cell phone is not working.  Back at Ezra's apartment , Garrett Reynolds knocks on the door. As Ezra lets him in, he apologizes for the mess. Evidence that a girl has been there is obvious, as the bed is unmade, a girly garment is hanging off a chair, and the brown paper bag masks are lying conspicuously on the couch. Garrett takes a mental note and then tells Ezra he would like to speak to him about one of his students.  Hanna watches as Caleb boards the bus leaving Rosewood , feeling frustrated that he didn’t even say goodbye to her, even though she had avoided him when he tried to approach her. They make eye contact but don’t exchange any words.  Finally, Spencer is released. She comes face-to-face with Ian, holding the crowbar. She expects him to strike her, but he's with the rest of her family, who are worried about her. They criticize the negligence of management while Spencer gets a real text from Toby asking where she is. She is shaken, but unharmed. Her family leads her home, but Spencer stops following when she catches sight of Toby. Despite her mother's wishes to keep walking and stay away, she runs straight into Toby's arms and kisses him, disturbing her family and Mrs. Ackard .  Thanks to the snowglobe clue, Emily, Aria, and Hanna track down a secret storage location. There, they uncover a flash drive contained in an old lunch box stored in a garage Alison had planted! The flash drive contains secret N.A.T. videos, mainly of the girls in intimate moments. While she was alive, Alison somehow knew they were being spied on. There's footage of July 4th moments before " The Jenna Thing ," when Ali had been sure someone was spying on them in Emily's room. There's even footage of Jenna. The girls begin to understand what Jenna was seeking when enlisting Caleb to search Hanna's hard drive, as in the footage, she's seducing and blackmailing Toby. The episode concludes with black gloved "A" swiping the key from underneath Ezra's doormat.

title: For Whom the Bell Tolls
summary: At the beginning of the episode, the girls are still in Emily's room (as they had been in the previous episode ), watching the footage contained on Ali's flash drive. Spencer comes up with the idea of asking Jenna what she knows before taking the information to the police to incriminate Ian . The other Liars aren't so sure; they don't think they can trust Jenna at all, but Spencer is adamant.  At the Montgomerys , Ella is over helping Byron with some parental responsibilities. He lets her know he's planning a faculty mixer at the house that night and invites her to join. As they speak, Aria eavesdrops before showing herself. As her mother talks, Aria glances at her text messages and sees one from Ezra warning her that a cop had been over. Aria freaks out and yells at Ella, telling her to decide her feelings for Byron because her indecisiveness is hurting the whole family.  At Hanna's , Ashley tries to snap Hanna out of moping over Caleb . She's surprised to hear Caleb never delivered the letter he planned to give her the day before.  Meanwhile, Melissa makes plans to go to the church to plan a christening for her unborn baby . Emily is in her room, messaging Samara on her laptop. Pam enters and asks to talk to Emily. She lets Emily know Wayne has been reassigned to work in Texas and informs Emily that the family is moving to Texas for a year to be with him.  At school , Aria meets Ezra, extremely alarmed by his texts. Fortunately, his news is positive; Officer Garrett Reynolds didn't want to speak to him about Aria when he said "student." The "student" was Spencer; he asked Ezra some questions about Spencer's connections to the props in the school play (and though he doesn't say it, the fake Ian trophy). Aria actually punches him in the shoulder for scaring her so much with the texts. Ezra also has news that he's resigning from Rosewood High to work at Hollis College instead, rendering his relationship with Aria less problematic. Ezra plans to come to Aria's house for her father's Hollis faculty mixer, and they make plans for Aria to show Ezra her room.  After class, Hanna asks Mona whether Caleb had tried to give her anything at the Founder's Day Festival. Mona saying lets pretend he did, not really answering the question, seemingly trying to protect Hanna's well-being. Lucas overhears their conversation and afterwards makes a face at Hanna. He is still mad at her for treating him poorly at the dance-a-thon.  In the school music room, the Liars confront Jenna about the incriminating video they found of her and Toby . Jenna tells her story, how Alison visited her at the hospital on the day she disappeared and threatened Jenna never to reveal the truth about " The Jenna Thing ," or face having her inappropriate relationship exposed. Alison played footage of her seducing Toby and used it as blackmail. Before she left Jenna, Alison warned her never to return to Rosewood , or she would bury her. Jenna asks what the girls are going to do with the video. They assure her they'll keep it safe as long as she holds the secret about the Jenna Thing –but she won't be getting it. Jenna seems to be telling the truth when she discloses what Ali said to her at the hospital. The Liars believe, as it explains Jenna's seemingly strange speech at the memorial dedication.  At lunch, Spencer presents the other Liars with a burner cell phone they can use to text Ian anonymously. Hanna texts him a blackmail message demanding $10,000 in exchange for the videos. While they plot, they spot Ian standing by the snack machine in the cafeteria. When Ian gets the text, he immediately leaves the cafeteria to take care of it. They set a place for Ian to meet just before Mona swings by to sit with them. However, as soon as she arrives, the girls all split, leaving Mona by herself with her lunch tray. Hannah forgot her cell phone, and after she leaves, her phone rings with an incoming call from Caleb. Mona picks up to speak to Caleb; she tells him she gave Hanna the letter, but she/Hannah threw it in the trash (a blatant lie).  Suddenly, Mona looks up to see Lucas standing over her. He is immediately suspicious of Mona and what she had to do with Caleb leaving town. In response, Mona apologizes for always teasing Lucas, claiming it was just a joke. She also offers him a makeover, tempting him with the prospect of obtaining Hanna, but Lucas clearly doesn't take the bait.  Next, Jenna receives a phone call from Ian . She lets him know the Liars have the video footage and have seen it all. Ian tells her not to worry; he'll take care of it. Ian turns on his car and starts driving somewhere in the woods.  To keep his cover and instill trust, Garrett corners Emily as she gets out of her car near her house and offers his help, should the girls need anything. He even invites her to his family's movie night, but she declines. Emily then walks over to Hanna , sitting on her stoop, to return her phone. Hanna comforts Emily about her imminent move to Texas. Neither feels like being alone.  Toby and Spencer are seen in Spencer's room reading and studying, respectively, until Toby calls Spencer over to sit on his lap by the window.  In her room, Jenna complains that Alison is taunting her from the grave. She turns to Garrett Reynolds , who lets her know he will make sure nothing happens. He then kisses her.  At the faculty mixer, Aria opens the door for Jackie Molina and reacts awkwardly. Ezra sees her head upstairs, then realizes why. Jackie and Ezra share a smile when they catch sight of each other. Ezra finally sees Aria's room, but under different circumstances than they both imagined. Aria questions Ezra about how he could have omitted telling her that Jackie would be coming and that she also works at Hollis College. She equates it to lying despite his excuses and then turns from him angrily, leaving him standing there in her room.  After a while, Spencer gets a text from her sister saying Ian never showed up, and so she needs a ride home from the church. Toby tells Spencer he'll keep Jenna busy like she wants him to, but he wishes he were going with her to the $10K meet-up. She tells him he's helping her by finding out if Jenna's involved in all of the bad stuff, or not. She then tells him he is her safe place to land, and that she wants him to stay safe. They kiss again.  Hanna decides to delete Caleb from her phone's contacts, shedding a few more tears in the process. Meanwhile, we see Lucas driving Caleb back to Rosewood, Pennsylvania, after his time in Arizona. He is doing this for Hanna's happiness.  Spencer goes to pick Melissa up from the church, where she has been planning the christening for her unborn child. Melissa can't find her phone and believes she left it in the church. She and Spencer agree to go back for it just when a car comes out of nowhere, colliding with the sisters. Spencer is okay, but Melissa gets injured. The accident is a hit-and-run, as they don't know with whom they've collided.  While Spencer is busy with the aftermath of the accident and the baby being monitored, Hanna, Emily, and Aria work on trapping Ian. They call Spencer at 7:30 pm. Still, unbeknownst to them, she is at the hospital.  At the hospital , Spencer fills Veronica in on everything that happened. A police officer approaches Spencer to hand her, her bag, which was recovered from her vehicle. She opens her phone to find unanswered texts from her friends asking where she is. Spencer offers to go back to the church for Melissa's phone since it's only a couple of blocks away.  Back at the meeting point, the girls get a text from "A," warning them to "Buckle up," though the girls aren't sure for what. Spencer finally calls Aria, saying she is in the hospital. Emily takes Garrett up on his offer for help and confides in him about the Ian situation. He shows up in his personal car wearing civilian clothes. However, Ian fails to show. Instead, a messenger boy with a sack of cash goes in his place; Officer Reynolds corners him. He turns the messenger away without telling the girls what he has done, though the girls have already caught sight of the messenger. Garret corners the guy, and he tells him he got the job from Ian, saying his name is Logan Reed . Ian seems to have disappeared, leaving his injured pregnant wife to cope with the stress alone.  Spencer goes to the church to get Melissa's phone. She calls out for the Reverend, then begins searching. Ian shows up and corners Spencer – it's not a good situation at all! He calls the anonymous number that was used to text him, and a distinctive ringing is heard from Spencer's bag. She tries to use the fact that Melissa was in an accident to derail him, but he doesn't go for it. So, she takes the flash drive from her bag and holds it up. He starts chasing her, so she throws the flash drive to throw him off her trail. (It's unclear whether there is a backup copy.) She starts running up the church tower to get away from him, but he's able to corner her. When Spencer gets Hanna , Emily , and Aria on the phone, they can hear her entire fight with Ian at the church, including his whole plan for staging Spencer's suicide and to frame her for Ali's murder! Knowing how much danger she's in, they rush to save her and dial 911.  Ian wraps his hands around Spencer's neck and makes a move to throw her down the bell tower. Spencer catches onto the ledge before she falls. Before Ian can ply Spencer's hands free, a figure approaches. Ian seems to know who it is, as he asks, "What are you doing here?" The mysterious figure, donned in A's usual black hoodie and gloves, saves Spencer by pushing Ian to what appears to be his death as he dangles motionlessly, entangled in the church bell's ropes. The ropes envelope his neck and appear as if they've strangled him. Spencer props herself back up to a secure spot on the ledge just as the rest of the girls arrive to see she is physically okay, but very shaken.  Later, the girls walk out of the church together, but are stopped when Officer Barry Maple calls them back to ask if their story is a joke. He can see the confusion on their faces, so he motions the girls to follow him into the church. Inside, they see that the bell tower is indeed empty, and Ian’s body is nowhere to be found. Much of the town emerges to see what the commotion is about, and Rosewood is left to wonder just how much truth the girls have been telling. Meanwhile, the girls all receive simultaneous messages from A, saying, “It is not over till I say it is, sleep tight while you still can, bitches —A,” assuring the girls this is far from over.

title: It's Alive
summary: Season 2 picks up with the aftermath of the Ian - Spencer chase in the church . Officer Garrett Reynolds takes the girls in his cop car to the police station, but shadily stops at an undisclosed location on the way to "straighten the girls' stories out." He conveniently orders them to remove his participation from the retelling and not to mention blackmailing Ian at all. He claims he's hiding the money the messenger brought, and he won't be giving them any trouble. Most importantly, he asks them to keep the videos a secret. They head towards the precinct without noticing the figure standing close to where the girls were standing - Jenna !  The next day, the girls chill out in Spencer's room to review the events of the night. They are confused about "A's" motives in saving Spencer's life. They go downstairs to make coffee and find all of their parents standing in Spencer's kitchen. The parents seem skeptical about the girls' story. They call Spencer's accusations an "obsession to pin Alison's death on Ian." The girls are entirely defensive, and their parents insist they seek therapy.  Just then, at an already tense moment, Toby stops by to see Spencer. Spencer’s dad sends him away in an attempt to protect his daughter’s reputation from further damage. The rude remarks to Toby sent Spencer, followed by the others flying back up the stairs, sans coffee.  That night, Jenna and Officer Garrett are together in a car staking out the former DiLaurentis house , questioning why Jason would move back there. They mysteriously allude to a "Jason thing" and wonder if he's looking for something that they won't refer to aloud.  Back at school, Aria is chatting with her mother in the hallway. They discuss their family situation; Ella announces she plans to move back home.  Meanwhile, the rest of the school is abuzz with rumors about the girls’ story. Mr. Fitz erases a damning hangman meant to spell out “LIARS” drawn on the board. Then, Noel , back from his suspension, waltzes back into class, rudely remarking about the drawing on the blackboard: Aria and Spencer exchange pained looks.  In the hallways, a few girls gossip about the girls and what happened while practically standing next to Hanna. But Mona comes to the rescue and disses the girls for their pathetic gossip mongering. Meanwhile, Spencer and Aria talk about Noel being back at school after suspension, being more popular than ever.  Ezra beckons Aria to speak privately in the classroom, but Aria is uncommunicative and does not want to talk about what happened, shutting Ezra out. Ezra tries to apologize about Jackie , but Aria is mostly unresponsive and leaves their relationship status up in the air.  After school, Spencer visits Toby’s house , but Jenna answers the door and slams it in his face, claiming that her parents won’t allow him to see Spencer.  Meanwhile, just as Emily is re-watching the Jenna and Toby video, a real estate agent named Mr. Mendez comes in to appraise the room. He's putting the Fields' house on the market with the anticipation of the family's upcoming move to Texas. He basically criticizes anything that makes the room feel inhabited and homey, and Emily is heartbroken.  Back at the Hastings’ residence, Officer Garrett is speaking with Melissa and her parents regarding Ian , a missing person, not a murder victim . He is trying to locate Ian for her; he returns her cell phone - the police found it in the church. Spencer then blasts her parents for not believing her story; she re-declares Ian dead despite her mother’s protests. She blames them for siding with Melissa as usual.  In the therapist's office , the girls sit silently. Hanna walks in late, hoping to have missed the whole appointment, but to her annoyance, the girls have "politely" waited for her. When they finally do get to talking, they speak minimally. Aria is the most tempted to confide in the inviting Dr. Sullivan , especially about " that thing ," but their cellphones go off, scaring them with reminders of what "A" might do if they tell. The session ends with Dr. Sullivan remaining entirely in the dark.  We next see Lucas rolling Caleb back into Rosewood . Lucas protectively warns Caleb not to hurt Hanna again.  Outside the office, Spencer sees Toby escorting Jenna into a car. He smiles at Spencer, but doesn't walk over. Then, the girls catch sight of a picture of themselves blasted on the town newspaper, with the caption, "What really happened?" The newspaper's theory is that Ian skipped town. Despite Officer Garrett 's promises, Ian's money and a suitcase were found near his car at the end of town. "A" uses their shock as prime time to send a new text: "I spy liars."  Later that day, Hanna returns home with shopping bags full of her day's shop-a-thon. She rambles on about the sales until she catches sight of Caleb seated quietly in her kitchen beside her mother . But Hanna isn't thrilled. She treats Caleb coldly, even when he makes cute forgive-me eyes at her. She learns Caleb tried to give her a letter (via Mona ) to say goodbye. He came to her house to apologize, but Hanna didn't forgive him. He says, "I love you," but her mind is made up. When he leaves, she cries.  At the café, Hanna expresses her hurt to Mona for lying to her about Caleb and the letter. Mona tries to explain why she did it, but Hanna isn't interested. Just then, Noel arrives to bestow a kiss on Mona. Apparently, they are dating now. Mona seems upset when Hanna walks away.  Spencer is trying on different outfits, set to meet Emily (and Toby), until Melissa walks in, suddenly civil towards Spencer. She apologizes for screaming at Spencer before and confides in Spencer the name they plan to give their child. She then asks Spencer to retell the story of what happened to Ian , as she's willing to listen now. She knows what the papers say isn't true; Ian would never skip town on her and their baby like that. Spencer cancels her date with Toby, opting to have a heart-to-heart with Melissa instead.  Toby hangs out in Emily’s room , disappointed that Spencer won’t join, but happy to be rekindling his friendship with Emily again. Emily apologizes for believing he could have been the one to kill Alison. He forgives her and notes how easy it has been to pick up their friendship right where they left off. He uses his carpentry skills to remove Emily’s childhood height markings from the wall so she won’t lose the memento forever, as the realtor wanted her to paint over it.  That day after school, Aria decided to make an appearance at Ezra's place . There, shirtless Ezra assures Aria he believes she and her friends are telling the truth about the Ian incident. He offers his support to Aria. She says she feels like things have changed. Ezra says she can ask him anything - Aria is curious to hear more details about Jackie . He tells her Jackie wasn't ready for a commitment and assures her she is not a rebound, but cannot bring himself to lie and say he wasn't still in love with Jackie when he first met Aria. He promises he was never thinking about anyone else while they were together. Ezra asks her to spend the rest of the day with him, like they used to, but Aria declines. She tells him she's spending Sunday with her family and that she'll see him Monday. Outside, Aria receives a text containing a picture of Ezra's desk in his apartment. "A" claims something is missing. Aria instinctively looks under the doormat to find Ezra's key gone! Will she let him know he needs to change his locks?  At Emily's place , Aria informs the crew about the missing key. They contemplate "A’s" compulsively violent tendencies and violation of their personal space. They bring up Dr. Sullivan, who is sworn to confidentiality - Emily and Aria are the loudest proponents in favor of cluing her in on their secrets. Spencer agrees, and even Hanna does too, because as the most unwilling to see a shrink, she approves of Dr. Sullivan’s fashion sense - a clear signal to Hanna about her character.  At Dr. Sullivan 's, the girls are about to tell all. Emily takes out her computer to show Anne the videos taken of them through the window, but decides to explain the situation first. Aria begins to speak, but is cut off by Spencer, who catches sight of Ezra's college diploma on the wall - a subtle hint that "A" is privy to everything they say. They scheduled this appointment last minute, yet they suddenly canceled, leaving Dr. Sullivan completely baffled and frustrated with the lack of communication. She noticed that their decision to turn back, once on the brink of telling her something important, stemmed from one of the girls having slowly spread to the other four, but she couldn't figure out why. We later find out she believes the girls are not benefiting from therapy by coming as a group, and so recommends to their parents to have them separate for a while, both during treatment and socially. The girls are all devastated as their parents inform them one by one.  Just then, Spencer hears someone outside her house. Thinking it's Ian coming to finish what he started, she runs to lock as many doors as she can, but is too slow to lock them all. Whoever it is finds an open entrance, so Spence grabs a knife, shuts off the lights, and hides crouched behind the counter. Her heart stops pounding when she discovers it was Toby ; the two embrace.  Meanwhile, as Dr. Sullivan leaves her office, she feels the creepy sensation that she's being followed, and even sees a shadowy silhouette cast beside hers on the sidewalk. But when she turns, she sees nobody.  Back at the Hastings’ residence , Spencer glances at her sister’s beeping cell phone, which has just received a text from a restricted number saying, “Melissa, I’m sorry, but it’s not safe yet. Can’t talk yet.” Is this from Ian? Is he really alive?  Spencer sends an S.O.S text to the girls, who must sneak out of their homes to rendezvous in the middle of the night. They meet in an abandoned greenhouse to discuss the possibility of Ian being alive and texting Melissa . They test the texter to see if they know the name Ian and Melissa agreed upon for their unborn child. The texter answers correctly. The girls are spooked, but is the hooded figure watching overhead messing with them? Spencer did utter the name out loud before said texter gave the reply.  While the realtor is showing Emily's room to a so-called prospective buyer, the client deletes Emily's entire hard drive while wearing the familiar black leather gloves.

title: The Goodbye Look
summary: At the beginning of the episode, the girls are still in the greenhouse , where they met for their late-night secret meeting (after their parents told them to take a time out from each other). They discuss the possibility of Ian being alive and how to return Melissa's phone before she detects it missing. They hear rustling around them, the door shuts, and rocks are dropped onto the ceiling from above. It seems clear that someone is standing atop the greenhouse, observing their conversation, unbeknownst to the Pretty Little Liars. Spooked, the girls flee.  On their way home, they pass the DiLaurentis house , where Jason is standing on the curb, disposing of the rest of the Ali memorial paraphernalia that Maya's family apparently didn't have the heart to get rid of. The girls are surprised to see him back in Rosewood and back in his old house.  At the Marins , Hanna argues with her mother over her father's return. At the Fields' home , Emily is also arguing with her mother , but about her cell phone privileges. Pam orders Emily to leave her phone on the kitchen table whenever she returns home from school . She's allowed to receive and place phone calls, but only from the kitchen, where her mother can guarantee that Emily is not speaking to any of the other Little Liars. Before Pam exits, she lets Emily know that a family is lined up to lease their home for the following year. To make matters worse, Emily finds her hard drive wiped! Emily secretly calls Spencer , who is equally upset to hear that their video evidence is gone.  Spencer gets off the phone just as Melissa returns home, a sonogram photograph in hand. The picture moves Spencer, and then she regrets the fact that her sister had to attend her appointment alone. She offers to accompany her for the next one - and also to stay home from school to take Melissa's messages. But Melissa declines Spencer's offer, pointing out that if the police were to call about Ian, she would want to pick up. Spencer wonders if Melissa is expecting a call from someone other than the police.  At school, Aria is cold towards Ezra when he attempts to be friendly. She accuses him of not letting her know about his last day on the job, which was Friday, and not being clear enough about what to expect after he packs up his desk. He feels he's been clear about how he feels, but that they won't be able to figure things out before the next bell. She finally consents to meeting Ezra in his apartment the next day to sort out the complicated details of their relationship .  In the hallway, Mona catches up with Aria and asks her to pick out the farewell gift for Ezra. Aria initially tenses up when Mona asks her, afraid that Mona is onto their romance, but Mona merely points out that she was his stage manager and had worked closely with him, so she knows him best. Aria accepts, but when Mona asks her to step in with Hanna on her behalf, Aria flatly declines. With annoyance, Aria reminds Mona that she isn't hanging out with Hanna at this time. Mona asks why, seeming completely oblivious to the news about Ian and the bell tower, then suddenly remembers. Mona seems understanding of Aria's point of view as she leaves, and decides to come up with a way to win back Hanna's friendship on her own.  During lunch, the girls stand in line in the cafeteria together, trying to catch up on each other's news discreetly. Hanna then plops her tray down at the same table where Aria is sitting, but Spencer protests, reminding her of their forced separation. Hanna is defiant, thinking this will only make them look more guilty, and further arguing that they should stick together amidst all the confusion, but in the end, they opt to sit at different tables. Just then, Mona motions for Hanna to sit beside her at her lunch table, but Hanna leaves, annoyed. With the girls all at separate tables, " A " sends the girls a text, mocking them for looking so lonely. Even after their therapist instructs them to stop socializing together, our girls continue to talk to each other because there's just so much to discuss!   Later, while sitting at an outside bench at the school, Spencer spots Toby . She's hopeful that he's returning to Rosewood High, but he's only there to pick up some GED paperwork. She tries to convince him to return, but Toby is not interested, especially because he just landed a construction job working for an established company. Spencer is happy for him, and Toby reveals that he plans to work hard to leave his parents' home. Spencer worries this means that Toby will leave Rosewood - and her - but Toby reassures her he isn't ready to let go of her just yet.  Next, Emily is at her swim meet. She wins the race for her team, and Samara greets her to congratulate the win. Samara tries to convince Emily to go out on a date with her, but Emily has mixed feelings. She likes Samara, but is afraid to get into a romantic relationship just when she's set to leave Rosewood. Then, Ken Rabin , a scout for Danby University, approaches Emily to discuss her college prospects. He gives her his card; Samara is hopeful.  That night, at the Hastings' home , Spencer is moving store-bought brownies to a plate and tries to comfort a frustrated Melissa by offering her one. Melissa calls Spencer out on trying to pass off store-bought goods as homemade, promising not to tell, and asks who they are for. Spencer replies that they're for Jason , a neighborly gesture to welcome him back to Rosewood. Melissa reacts disapprovingly. When Spencer questions Ian's connection to Jason, Melissa snaps angrily at Spencer, bringing up Ian to her.  At the Marins , Hanna has to contend with both her parents trying to convince her to do something she doesn't want to do. Tom warms to the therapist's idea, and Ashley has a 'why not' attitude, but Hanna has other ideas. She's angriest about the not-seeing-her-friends aspect and balks when her father suggests the decision can be 'adjusted' in the future. She finds her father's involvement hypocritical, when he has had such little interaction with her in the first place. As a result, her father announces he will be sticking around Rosewood for a while. Hanna's not impressed and walks away, rebuffing her father's attempt to endear his daughter. Ashley questions whether Tom's announcement was a reaction to Hanna's accusation or a premeditated thought, and Tom responds that it was the latter. He tries to endear his ex-wife by offering her a martini, a pastime of the former couple, but she rebuffs his offer too, firmly suggesting wine instead.  Meanwhile, Emily is packing up her room when Pam comes in. She wants to know if Emily has any ideas where their missing camping and winter gear has gone, but Emily is as surprised to hear of the property loss as Pam is. Then, Pam informs Emily that the Watsons also had some stuff go missing, leading them to conclude that the lost items were the result of a break-in. Pam goes to call the police, but before she leaves, she reminds Emily to hand her phone to be brought down to the kitchen table.  Spencer then walks over to Jason's house, bearing gifts. She spots a puppy rummaging through a patch of dirt in the front yard and coos sweetly to it. Just then, Jason barges out of the house and throws a newspaper at the puppy, who scampers away, afraid. A little put off, Spencer tries to salvage the situation by offering a welcoming present. Jason brings up the Ian incident, and Spencer asks Jason about his return to Rosewood, guessing it's to tie up loose ends. Jason asks Spencer if what the police said was true: had Spencer really told them that Ian confessed to killing Alison? She brings up the way the press describes it, but ultimately affirms that Ian suggested he killed Alison. Jason is unsatisfied, demanding to know whether Ian absolutely admitted to killing Alison, and Spencer wavers a little. She thinks he is passionate about this point because he and Ian were once close, but she doesn't know that Jason has another motive in securing this point so deeply. Finally, Jason turns and goes back into the house, letting the door shut loudly behind him.  While still standing on the stoop, Spencer flashes back to one summer when Ali and the girls were lounging in the DiLaurentis' front yard. Jason stormed out of the house, accusing Alison of messing with his stuff. She retorted sharply, mocking him and his friends for being stoners; the girls laughed. When Jason went back into the house, they questioned whether Alison had stolen what he claimed she had. She admitted it gleefully! When Emily asked her if she was worried whether Jason would rip apart her room in search of his things, she mischievously replied that he would never find what she hid. Just then, a smashing sound was heard from inside the house. Spencer snaps back to reality as Jason's porch light switches off.  At school, Emily meets with the Danby scout to discuss her college prospects. He is clearly impressed with her and thinks she has a great chance of winning a scholarship to Danby, but is concerned about her imminent move out of the district. He doubts another school will have a swim team that rates as high as Rosewood's does. Emily glosses over this fact, calling the move indefinite, and states she plans to finish high school in Rosewood.  After school, Spencer drops by the construction site to visit Toby , where he's working. Her face falls when she sees Toby looking crestfallen as Mr. Sweeney, the site manager, hands something to Toby, apologizes, and slowly shakes his head. He slowly approaches the car and lets Spencer know that the homeowner told the site manager to get Toby off her property, as she has young daughters at home. Mr. Sweeney dismissed Toby so as not to lose the client, but at least paid him for the whole week before letting him go. Spencer is outraged, but Toby is jaded. Spencer tries to convince Toby to get in the car, but he declines.  Later, Aria gets a call from Ezra , while waiting for him in his apartment, as per their agreement. Ezra is stuck in a meeting with his new employers at Hollis College , surprised by how long the meeting has gone. Aria is frustrated, thinking that this should have been anticipated, but she agrees to wait for Ezra in his apartment a while longer until he comes home. After getting off the phone, Aria pulls out Ezra's diploma from her knapsack and replaces it on his desk.  At the Fields' home , Emily is desperately trying to impress upon her mother the importance of continuity in her education, based on her conversation with the scout. Pam sees Emily's point that her leaving Rosewood High could jeopardize her chances of obtaining a swim scholarship. Still, she's reluctant to change her family's plans based on one conversation with a college scout. She says she would need a written commitment from the university, and Emily seems sure this can easily be procured. The conversation gives her new hope.  Aria calls Spencer seeking advice about how to deal with her confusing situation of her relationship with Ezra . She calls Spencer an excellent decision maker, but before Spencer can be of much help, she gets a knock at the kitchen door and hangs up with Aria. Aria collapses into Ezra's armchair, sighing. Spencer then opens the door to greet Toby, who invites her for a walk. Growing more and more impatient, Aria starts pacing Ezra's apartment , trying to busy herself while she waits. She receives a text from him asking her to stay; she rolls her eyes. After pacing restlessly for a while longer, she pens a letter to him explaining she has decided she can't make their relationship work. She leaves it perched in the typewriter's output and finally leaves his empty apartment.  At the Marins' home , Hanna ignores Mona's phone messages as she does the dishes. Her father lightly questions her about it, but she is mostly unresponsive. He apologizes for Hanna's not being able to see her friends, but calls it the right thing to do. Hanna then points out that she only sees him when she's in trouble - not ready for her father's return to her good graces. She accuses him of abandoning her and listens placidly as he apologizes.  At the movie theater on her date, Emily fills Samara in on the possibility of her staying in Rosewood. Samara is happy to hear it, and the conversation moves to first girlfriends, as a glossy stare comes over Emily's face, thinking about her past date with Maya in this same place. They confide in each other about their pasts and smile at their newfound closeness.  Next, Mona is sitting alone in a bar until Hanna shows up, ready to forgive Mona for hiding the letter Caleb wrote for her. Mona is very pleased to have her friend back. They agree to disagree on each other's love interests ( Noel and Caleb), deciding to avoid that subject altogether as their relationship heals.  On their forest walk, Spencer and Toby discuss the text message supposedly sent by Ian. They stare at Rosewood from above, comparing it to a monster, or simply a town full of monsters, then comfort each other about their reputations.  Meanwhile, Aria approaches Spencer's door, hoping to catch her friend who is out on a walk. She sees that a pane of glass is shattered and walks into the house, stepping over the glass. Scared, she calls out Spencer's name, when suddenly, a black hooded figure shoves Aria into a bank of cabinets, causing her to fall backward and lose her shoe. The figure runs out of the house, literally a thief in the night. When Spencer returns, she calls the police, comforting Aria. The Liars assume the burglar is "A," but Aria brings up other recent burglaries in the town. Spencer poses that the burglar could be "A," but points out that Ian is a possibility as well. The two girls grow more afraid as they consider the possibility that Ian was in the house, looking for Spencer.  The next day, Friday, Emily meets with the Danby scout, expecting him to grant her the letter she wants, but he says that all he can offer her is a maybe letter. Emily tries to conceal her disappointment as he leaves.   Later, in English class, Ezra uses his last moments with the Rosewood High students to give a parting speech. It is given to the whole class, but the innuendo is clearly intended for Aria alone, telling what an unexpected sense of loss he feels leaving and that he'll never forget their time together. The other Pretty Little Liars no doubt pick up on the subtext as well as Aria, who sits somewhat uncomfortably in her seat. After class, Aria does not approach Ezra right away, but silently broods over his words, remaining in school, while everyone else leaves. Suddenly, overcome with regret for letting him go, she rushes into his classroom, only to see it empty. She then catches sight of Ezra outside the window, packing up his car against the twilight. She chases him down, calls out his name, runs to embrace him, and the two kiss passionately.  At Spencer's home , Melissa sits on the couch, silent and motionless. Spencer returns home at the end of the day and asks Melissa if she left the house that day. While Spencer hangs her jacket up, she catches sight of Melissa's boots covered in mud, no doubt from the recent rain. She also sees the sonogram picture in Melissa's coat pocket. Spencer gathers the other Pretty Little Liars for a walk near her house to catch them up on the prospect of Melissa having gone to see Ian to show him the photo.  Just then, Jason walks by and notes the girls' presence. They ask him about the dirt upheaved in his yard. He responds that it's some planting he's undertaking, in addition to building a fence, which he says is for privacy and security. When everyone leaves, the puppy comes back to the front yard, but this time, a black leather-gloved figure is petting it.

title: My Name Is Trouble
summary: At the Hastings' , Spencer awakes from a nightmare. In her dream, the four girls were at the movies discussing Jason 's return to Rosewood when Spencer caught sight of a figure behind them out of the corner of her eye. When the girls think it's safe, a dark hooded figure rushes at them with a flashlight. When she awakes, Melissa is shining a flashlight in her sister's face as she roughly searches for her misplaced wedding ring on the couch on which her sister is sleeping, not caring at all that she has woken her up. Melissa reveals she removed her diamond ring because her fingers were swelling up due to the pregnancy. While Melissa is looking for it, Spencer tries to spy on Melissa's cell phone to see if Ian has recently contacted her, but Melissa is protective and doesn't let Spencer anywhere near her phone.  At school , the girls find ways to secretly meet by hiding in the bathroom stalls until the bathroom is empty. While they discuss the latest news, including the possibility that Melissa is hiding Ian, Hanna gives out hand cream, which she reveals she pilfered from the mall. The girls are appalled to hear Hanna is still shoplifting, but Hanna wants out anyway because shoplifting with Mona is boring. When someone enters, they split as if being there all together is a coincidence.  Spencer catches sight of Toby in the hallway; he tells her he's there for paperwork for his GED. Spencer is concerned when he reveals that he got a job as a carpenter at Jason's house. She doesn't trust Jason and suspects he may be hiding Ian in his house. Wanting Toby as far from Jason as possible, Spencer is determined to buy Toby the truck he's saving up for - and Toby's independence. She makes him promise not to enter the house; he agrees.  Meanwhile, Hanna is eating when she sees Lucas ; she asks him to sit down with her. He reveals his parents are allowing Caleb to stay at their house. Seeing her all alone and feeling bad for her, the Liars won't let them hang out with each other. He asks her to help him with yearbook duties.  Following their therapist ’s advice to maintain separate lives, Aria enrolls in an extension course at the college where Ezra works. While on campus, Aria and Ezra revel in the fact that they can outwardly show their affection for each other in public. The two lovers share a kiss, not realizing a stunned Jackie is eyeing them from across the way.  Aria is shocked to find Jenna is taking the same pottery class as her at Hollis. At first, she wants to switch into another class, but Ezra convinces her not to - thinking the two artistic girls will finally be able to get past their rivalry.  Aria deals with this new Jenna situation by pretending to be a student named Anita ; Jenna is none the wiser. Things get complicated when Jenna asks 'Anita' for help with specific tasks, like picking up dropped objects off the floor and helping her clean up. Jenna confides in 'Anita' about her desire to see sunlight hitting water again, getting very emotional from the memory - until she realizes Anita's voice is actually Aria's. She gets hysterical and screams at a distraught Aria to blow out the candle.  When Spencer visits Toby at work, she meets Jason , who lets her know he has left for the day. Spencer sees a shadowy figure inside Jason's house through the window. She asks Jason who is staying with him, but he pronounces he's inhabiting the house alone. Spencer is thus convinced Jason has something to hide. In the kitchen, Spencer confronts Melissa about her loyalties. She asks Melissa to protect her if someone (Ian) tries to hurt her. Annoyed, Melissa rebuffs Spencer's question and tells her she's not going to choose between her sister and her husband.  That night, suddenly afraid of sleeping in her house alone, Spencer calls Emily asking her to sleep over. Since the Liars are all banned from seeing each other, Emily replies that she can't. Spencer looks out her window and sees Jason inside the room opposite hers; he's newspapering the windows to conceal everything inside. Spencer is even more convinced of Jason's guilt. It prompts her to flashback to a time when Jason was having a party with his friends - a distraught Alison came to Spencer's house seeking refuge from the drunk boys at the party. She was in a tearful state, but lashed out when the girls tried to show her compassion and support - she insulted them and turned impersonal. Emily was over at the time as well, and the two girls wondered what had happened to Alison that upset her so much, other than party boys stumbling into her bedroom for all sorts of reasons. She makes up a story about her grandmother not being well, but the girls don't buy it.  Meanwhile, Hanna finds it surprising that Ashley is pandering to Tom's food preferences in preparation for his return to their home in Rosewood . Ashley tries to convince her daughter to give her father another chance, even though he's made mistakes. Later at home, Tom tells his daughter about some of the differences he's having with his fiancée, though Hanna isn't totally interested. She also doesn't seem upset to hear her father is having problems with Isabel . Later, when Hanna witnesses her father and mother getting along so well together again, she sees a text on her father's cell phone from Isabel apologizing for something. Hanna secretly deletes this message in hopes of giving her parents a second chance with each other.  At yearbook, Lucas wonders why Hanna is being so friendly to him, worried she has ulterior motives, but Hanna insists people can change. She even gets a pretty girl named Danielle (who Lucas is so obviously crushing on) to agree to go on a date with Lucas. Hanna convinces Danielle she's still stuck on Lucas to make him look good. Lucas is still suspicious and very nervous about Hanna's actions, but is eventually grateful to her.  In hopes of convincing her mom to stay in Rosewood, Emily considers faking a letter from the Danby College swim scout , saying that if she remains an MVP at Rosewood High , she can have a full-ride scholarship. She prints the letter on stationery similar to the one on which the scout writes his real letter and shows it to her friends. Hanna is encouraging, but Aria has learned that lying has not served them well in the past. In the end, Emily decides against the idea, tears up the letter, and stuffs it into her bedroom wastebasket. She is shocked when her mother receives the letter anyway, thanks to " A ". She finds a new letter from "A," replacing the one she tore up in her trash bin, letting her know that "A" has no intention of allowing Emily out of her sight in Texas.  Later, Spencer finds her sister's ring near the toaster. In a bold move, she pawns it (banks are closed that day) to buy Toby the truck he was saving up for. The store owner seems skeptical of Spencer's claim that it belongs to her, but takes the ring and gives her the cash all the same. She does plan to return for it in two days, though, after she can get the money out of the bank to repurchase it. After dropping off the truck, Toby and Spencer share their first "'I love you," initiated by Toby, and the two share a passionate kiss.  Later, the Little Liars spy on Melissa . As soon as Melissa leaves the house, they secretly follow her, hiding behind the bushes in the yard. Someone pulls up late at night in his car. The girls are shocked when they realize the driver getting out of the vehicle is Wren ! He hands Melissa a closed shopping bag; Spencer wisely guesses it contains painkillers for Ian.  Later, in the pawn shop, we see a black-gloved figure - no doubt "A" - forking over cash to the pawn shop owner, to buy Melissa's ring. The owner mumbles something about knowing that the girl wasn't telling the truth, though probably not too concerned, considering the cash in their hand. Spencer is gonna be upset.

title: Blind Dates
summary: The episode begins with the pawn shop owner expressing shock at seeing Spencer walk back through the door of his shop, just like she said she would, 48 hours after pawning Melissa 's diamond ring. To cover up his mistake, the owner pretends he doesn't recognize her, but as proof, Spencer hands him the receipt he gave her. He gives her a rusty horseshoe as the item that corresponds with the number on the receipt and hands her a phone to call the police if she wants to.  Meanwhile, Aria , Hanna , and Emily are waiting outside for her in the "skeevy" parking lot next to a dumpster. They discuss the oddness of Wren and Melissa's rendezvous the night before. Spencer comes out and reports the bad news - she basically stole her sister's wedding ring. Just then, they look up to see a creepy sign for an optometrist, with eyes bearing down on them, as if someone is watching them, as they know someone always is.... Just then, they get a text from " A " cluing them into who has the ring.  News flash for Aria: Now that Mr. Fitz will no longer be teaching at her high school, her mother, Ella , will be her new English teacher. Aria tries to conceal her disappointment and struggles with the weirdness of the arrangement. Back at the Hastings', Melissa is still searching for her ring AND for Ian's passport. She claims it's needed to claim her ring for the insurance company.  At Hanna's home, Hanna's mom requires Hanna to have a solo session with the therapist , to Hanna's chagrin, of course. Meanwhile, at Emily's, "A" sent a box of Danby paraphernalia (mug, sweatshirt, etc.) along with a note that says, "So happy to have you on our 'A-Team'!!!" Pam is as happy as ever, celebrating Emily's inevitable acceptance into Danby. Emily's conscience grows larger.  At school, Lucas is a total mess; he is beyond nervous about his upcoming date with Danielle . He persuades himself to call it off, but Hanna urges him not to. Lucas eventually gets Hanna to come along with Caleb , to make things more comfortable as a double date.   As usual, Ella takes advantage of seeing her daughter in the school hallway to exchange some words. Aria first promises she was only saying goodbye to her friends, who she is still banned from seeing, and then critiques and compliments her mom on her first class. Ella mentions she needs Aria to meet up with her brother, Mike , later, where he usually plays basketball, to return his keys, and then, to Aria's utter annoyance, Elle reminds her daughter to refrain from spending time with her friends - even in the school hallways.  During lunch, Caleb follows Hanna to try and convince her to agree to the double date with Lucas and Danielle. Hanna, still disgruntled by Caleb, refuses, but then gives in for Lucas' sake. She lets Caleb know she's only doing this for Lucas. Caleb stills seems satisfied to be going with her.   Later, Spencer finds Wren at the hospital where he works to let him know she saw Wren giving stuff to Melissa and to warn him that Ian had tried to kill her/Spencer. He tells her the bag contained strong painkillers, meaning Ian really is alive, though probably not in good shape. He explains he wanted to help Melissa because he feels responsible for Melissa getting back with Ian in the first place. In the end, not wanting to get involved, Wren turns Spencer down to help track down Ian.  At the therapist's office , Hanna is impatient and annoyed. She barely speaks to Dr. Sullivan and avoids opening up to her. Hanna leaves as soon as her hour is up, preventing the therapist's request for Hanna to role-play what she's feeling as if Alison were sitting there with them.  At the basketball court, Aria goes to find Mike , but only finds Mike's friends and, unexpectedly, Jason . His friends let her know he hasn't been around in months, and Jason theorizes Mike is doing things of which his family obviously would disapprove. Aria is worried, but grateful to Jason. For a moment, it seems like Jason is flirting when he tells her he remembers her pink hair highlights and misses her bold fashion statement. Aria is flattered.  At school, Samara is happy to hear about Emily's news (which she heard from Pam, who was gushing to just about everyone). Pam is super proud of Emily because she thinks Danby made a written commitment, and so is especially enthusiastic about Emily receiving a box of Danby paraphernalia. (The gift was actually courtesy of "A," not Danby, as Emily can guess based on the enclosed note.) Emily is immediately honest with Samara, letting her know she authored the letter, not the Danby coach. Just then, Pam sees the two together and invites Samara to celebrate at dinner, especially since Emily won't be celebrating with her usual friends. Samara accepts - this dinner seems like it'll be very different than the last time a girlfriend of Emily's came over. Samara offers to help keep Emily's secret should her mom get too nosy about the details.  At the Hastings' residence , Spencer walks into the barn with the door slightly open. Inside, she discovers a suitcase filled with men's clothing and toiletries, including shaving cream. Among the items are pain medications and pink lacy clothing that appear to belong to Melissa . Spencer also finds Ian's passport tucked inside the suitcase. While Melissa is taking a shower, she suddenly runs out in her bathrobe upon hearing a noise. Spencer hides, feeling suspicious of Melissa's frantic behavior.  Spencer calls Aria to fill her in, who is also alone in her home and equally scared as Spencer. When Mike comes home, he scares her by not speaking up when she asks who's there. She confronts him about his lies, but he brushes her off as he's not dealing with his transitioning family situation very well. Mike says if Aria tells their parents he hasn't been playing basketball every day after school, he will tell them she has been sneaking off to see her friends.  The scene then cuts to Hanna's place, where Caleb , Danielle , and Lucas have begun their evening. Danielle isn't enjoying the situation and suspects Hanna of still being "in love" with Lucas, being that she sold Lucas on Danielle by claiming she was still into him. She sees Hanna as ruining their date by walking over so frequently and constantly looking Lucas' way, misinterpreting Hanna's intention to see that Lucas shows Danielle a proper good time. So, Danielle likes Lucas, but is worried that Lucas is responsive to Hanna's moves.  Surprisingly, Pam is impressed by Samara , especially her appreciation of Pam's craftiness and her sweet, polite demeanor. The subject changes to Danby, and Samara tries to make things better for a guilt-ridden Emily, who seems about to confess. Samara convinces Pam that, given her swimming stats, there are other schools out there that would also love Emily . She dissuades Pam from contacting the Danby coach right away, as that would make them seem too eager and would therefore give other interested schools the wrong impression. Pam agrees, and Emily immediately feels less pressure.  Back at Hanna's , Lucas lets Hanna in on why Danielle is not enjoying their date, so to convince Danielle that she's not interested in dating Lucas , Hanna tells Caleb to put his arm around her. Seeing them together calms Danielle's suspicions, and she reaches for Lucas' hand.  The next day, Wren calls Melissa to arrange a meeting. With Spencer by his side, he persuades Melissa that he needs to accompany her to see Ian, as he is likely suffering from a severe staph infection. Later, Lucas expresses his gratitude to Hanna, praising her for being selfless and unlike Alison. This praise leaves Hanna deep in thought, leading her to Dr. Sullivan's office , where she requests an impromptu session to work through her feelings.  At Aria's home , her dad picks up on Mike 's abnormal behavior, but having been threatened by Mike that he would tell their parents about her hanging out with her friends, Aria denies what she knows. Mike forces Aria to agree that she saw him playing basketball today.  At the therapist's office , in hopes of getting some sense of closure, Hanna tells Dr. Sullivan her true feelings about Alison . Her role-playing makes it seem like Alison is really there, taunting Hanna for how she feels. She calls Alison her best friend, but also the worst enemy she has ever had. Alison is condescending, but Hanna doesn't allow the mental torture to continue. In her head, Alison says Hanna wouldn't have her friends had Ali not given them to her, and that Hanna can't live without her. But, mentally, Hanna lets the ghost know that she's over her, that she won't let her into her life anymore, and that she's ready to move on—music sets in, as if Hanna has broken a spell.  At school, Samara reiterates what she said to Emily's mom the other night; Emily happily reports that her mother has started to look at different colleges. They plan a second date.  At night, Dr. Sullivan , returns to finds her office only to find it in a shambles! Broken glass is everywhere; it's been completely trashed! She then turns to see a message scrawled on the wall in red paint: "Nosey Bitches Die." Maybe "A" is afraid of being found out?   Wren calls Spencer , who alerts the rest of the Liars to hit the road and join them. They're going 'Ian hunting.' But, at Hanna's home , her mom lets Hanna in on what happened to Dr. Sullivan's office . She's afraid because her daughter was the last patient in the office before everything went down. She asks Hanna what they discussed, but Hanna is reluctant; the point of confiding in the therapist is that it was confidential. But Hanna's mom is not so sure. The police could blame Hanna for the incident. Hanna leaves in a huff, frustrated by all the false accusations that never stop flying around. She goes to find "answers."  At the office , the police let Dr. Sullivan know there were no signs of forced entry. She confirms she's the only one who has a key to the office.    In the car on their way to find Ian , the girls discuss how screwed they are that they can't call the police - mainly because that only ever makes them suspicious. Emily wants to film this to prove their honesty later on. From inside an old barn that Melissa led Wren to, they hear Melissa let out a gut-wrenching scream followed by uncontrollable sobs. They run in, and Spencer goes to comfort her. But there on the floor of the barn lies Ian with dried blood around a wound on his head. He is holding a gun, and beside him lies a letter of confession that he killed Alison . Spencer and Wren exchange horrified looks, and the girls stare at the awful sight before them. But is it all over? Above them on the wall, some horseshoes are hung up, but there's a clear imprint where one is obviously missing. Is this a setup? Will Spencer, having the missing horseshoe, be tied to Ian's death? Will Melissa take Spencer's attempt to comfort her sister as genuine?  At the end, a gloved hand is seen putting Ian's phone into Spencer's purse.

title: The Devil You Know
summary: At the beginning of the episode, the girls discuss Ian's death and the plausibility of his wanting to kill himself. The Liars are ready to move on with their lives, but Emily is stuck on the details, not adding up to any logical sense. She decides to investigate independently. Just as the girls are talking, Garrett Reynolds appears. Based on the autopsy report, he lets the girls know Ian was dead for about a week, meaning the texts sent to Melissa were not from Ian!  At the Hastings' , Melissa is completely silent because she's traumatized. Also, because reporters are calling the house nonstop, making everyone frustrated, Spencer tells one caller off, only to discover it was her grandmother. Also, since Ian left behind only his aunt, the Hastings are left with the burial duties. Veronica doesn't want to get involved at all, but out of sympathy for Melissa, Spencer suggests a funeral to give her closure from her loss.  Caleb visits Hanna's home to see how she is after the traumatic incident. Hanna is still snappy towards Caleb, but she softens after seeing that Caleb is sincere. Ashley returns home frazzled that Hanna hasn't answered her phone, revealing how much stress Alison's death has placed on her, leading her to worry for her daughter's safety every time she leaves the house.  At Hollis , Aria is perched on Ezra's desk, cluing him in on the details of discovering Ian's body. They are sharing an intimate moment, which is silently overheard by Jackie , who purposely barges into the office to break up their tête-à-tête. Ezra awkwardly introduces Aria as a former student, rather than a friend, like Aria would prefer. The introduction forces her to call him Mr. Fitz. Jackie patronizingly calls Ezra by a nickname, probably to make Aria jealous, and later remarks that "Mr. Fitz" should start letting "the girl" call him by his first name.  At Speed Demon Express , Emily goes to pick up a package. The worker there looks familiar to her, and from an employee wall picture, she identifies him as Logan Reed , the guy who dropped off Ian's bribe in his stead.  Back at the Hastings ', Veronica apologizes to Spencer for not trusting her. She also acknowledges Spencer's hard work and sympathizes with her. She promises never to distrust her again, which she may or may not keep good on. She also lets her know that she's proud of her integrity in wanting to bury Ian for Melissa's sake. She informs her that Wren called to see how they're doing and that he's lucky it wasn't Peter who picked up the phone.  At Emily's place , Emily is reading, but distracted. She looks at Ian's suicide letter again and notices a pattern - many of the phrases he uses sound just like messages they've all received from "A."  While Emily starts conducting her research, Spencer conducts research of her own - trying to find an affordable wedding ring for Melissa to replace the one she lost. Frustrated, she realizes she will have to spend much more than she anticipated to replace it. Just then, "A" sends a text, threatening Spencer to reveal her role in Melissa's ring's disappearance - or face it resurfacing at the wrong time.  That night, a black-hooded figure tries to break into Jason's home . But Jason opens the door, exposing Mike in the act of attempted burglary. Jason informs Aria , who's grateful to Jason for not calling the cops. Jason says he's fed up with cops and also finds satisfaction in Mike learning his lesson now that he's been caught. Perhaps another motive for not involving cops is his budding attraction for Aria. Aria tries to question her brother about the incident at school, and it's revealed that Mike was the one who broke into Emily's garage and stole her camping equipment. He was also the one who broke into Spencer's kitchen and pushed Aria onto the floor as he fled the scene. He reveals he has broken into other homes as well. Aria agrees to keep it quiet, so as not to foil her family's tense relationship further, making Mike promise never to do it again.  At school, Hanna thanks Caleb for coming over. She's also concerned about his foster mother's treatment of him - getting money while treating Caleb like garbage when she does see him, and ignoring him the rest of the time; all the while, he doesn't even live with her! Caleb is touched, but not interested in trying to change anything - believing it is hopeless. But Hanna is outraged, especially when she later sees his foster mother at school, blaming Caleb for making her look bad when she's the one who doesn't know anything about her foster son's well-being. Caleb retorts, but does nothing else. So, later, Hanna takes matters into her own hands and threatens Janet , Caleb's foster mom, to pay up or face a lawsuit filed by her (pretend lawyer) mom. Caleb later visits Hanna to thank her, revealing that Janet took the threats seriously and indeed, paid up. Hanna's heart is officially melted, and she kisses Caleb before he leaves to hang out with Lucas.  Just before English class, Emily shares the news with her friends that "A" probably doctored the suicide letter. They are brought back to the scary reality of "A," having taken a respite when they thought Alison's killer was finally being put to rest.  So, Emily goes back to " Speed Demon Express " to question Logan . Logan is forthcoming, revealing he was hired online for a delivery position. He never interacted with his employer, except on the phone, and the voice of the employer was that of a woman, not a man.  At the Hastings ', Spencer tries to smooth things out with Melissa , but her attempt at a private conversation is interrupted by their mother's request for help with a chore. Melissa, meanwhile, remains silent and unresponsive.  Hanna talks with her mother about the upcoming funeral, experimenting with what to wear in preparation. She has a conversation with her mother about Ashley's father's funeral, and it's revealed that although Ashley paid for it, she never attended and does not regret that decision.  At the church for the funeral ceremony, Emily tries to tell Spencer what she learned from Logan . Spencer is not interested; her mind is too focused on her sister's well-being and family healing after this craziness. Emily then informs Garrett Reynolds of what she found out from Logan. He thanks Emily for confiding in him. Later, we see Officer Garrett paying Logan off to keep quiet about the bribe and to leave town, stopping Emily's investigation in its tracks. Garrett then calls Jenna to let her know it has been taken care of. We are to believe Jenna is the one who hired Logan over the phone.  Spencer's mom invited the other Liars to the funeral, suddenly regretting separating Spencer from her friends, in light of recent events. There, Mr. Fitz shows up. When questioned about his attendance by Ella and Byron Montgomery , Ezra is at first forthcoming, admitting that Aria invited him. However, he explains it was to support all of his former students. Aria is rebuffed, especially when her father acknowledges the gesture towards the "kids."  Ian is then buried, and the girls dust their hands of Ian and the earth that buries him. Aria and Emily spot Jason in the cemetery. Emily forms a negative opinion about him, but Aria doesn't seem to feel the same way. Ezra walks over to Aria, who was disappointed in the way he handled her parents earlier. She tells him she could really use a hug right now, but all he can offer is to call her later.  Aria then goes over to Jason. He confides in her that up until now, he believed he was the one who killed Alison , as he had blacked out drunk that night and had no recollection of what happened. He knows he acted violent whenever he got jealous, and he had been very envious of fearless Alison. He says he thinks he should have died instead of Alison, but Aria says he shouldn't believe that.  Then, Jason shows Aria a piece of paper he found the next day, warning him that someone knew what he did, though the reference is vague. That note always made him worry he might have been the one to harm Alison.  After the funeral, Melissa is finally ready to repair things with her sister. She apologizes for choosing Ian over her and for lying to her family. Spencer is about to confess to pawning her sister's ring, but Melissa interrupts, saying she needs to talk before she loses the courage. She is about to confide in her a secret when suddenly, a cell phone in Spencer's bag starts ringing. It belonged to Ian and had been planted in Spencer's bag by A. Melissa goes ballistic, thinking Spencer was the one posing as Ian, sending her text messages. Spencer is dumbfounded and hurt when Melissa says she will never forgive Spencer.  That night at the Montgomerys , Ella and Byron react to Ian's guilt in Alison's murder. Ella cannot believe she used to have such a cordial, unsuspecting relationship with Ian. Then, Mike informs his parents he is heading out to hang out with friends; his parent are unsuspecting of him as well. The couple jokingly opts for a strong drink of absinthe.  Then, the girls are summoned to another creepy midnight outing when Emily gets a message instructing her to go to the cemetery to visit a plot. The Liars join Emily, despite her being vague about why they're there. They end up at Alison's grave, where a wall across from them lights up. A projector is showing the remaining footage of Alison with Ian the night she died. The footage they thought was lost. This time, after falling to the floor, Alison gets up giggling. Ian puts on his jacket, kisses her, then turns and walks away.  The girls are now led to believe Ian did not kill Alison, and, just as Emily suspected, Ian's suicide was faked. They go in search of the projector, but a black-hooded figure, unseen by the girls, walks away with the projector in hand.

title: Never Letting Go
summary: On the eve of the Rosewood Charity Fashion Show, Aria , Emily , Hanna , and Spencer fold show programs on Emily's bed, trying to help Spencer make up for the fact that she has missed a bunch of fashion show committee meetings. They discuss their love lives, and the fact that Hanna has recently kissed Caleb , though she refuses to call him her boyfriend. Aria gets a text from Jason , telling her to meet him. The girls assume the text is from Ezra , and Aria does not correct them. Aria leaves to meet Jason outside in his car.  In the car, Jason makes Aria promise she wouldn't say anything about what he told her after the funeral. Aria assures him she won't, and thanks him again for helping her brother , Mike.  Back at the Marin residence , Tom and Ashley are cooking a farewell dinner, but Hanna is rude to her father , who plans to leave Rosewood tomorrow. She thinks it's typical of him to leave.  At the Hastings' residence , Spencer makes out with Toby in her kitchen. As soon as he leaves, she hears her dad on the phone with someone, yelling and complaining that Jason is home. Spencer tries to strike up a conversation with her father as he searches for an unhealthy nighttime snack. Melissa being on vacation is mentioned in passing. Spencer tries to press her father about the phone call, but he lies about it, a fact evident to Spencer when she presses redial to find the truth and discovers the call to have been with Jessica DiLaurentis !  At the Fields' home , Pam is on the phone with Wayne . When it is Emily's turn to speak, she asks him to proofread her paper for school, trying to maintain contact despite their long-distance relationship. Afterwards, Pam reveals that she badly misses her husband, although she had just visited him in Texas 3 days ago. This leads Emily to suggest that her mom spend a significantly more extended period of time in Texas, while Emily finishes her semester in Rosewood ; her mother says she'll think about it.  Just as Aria and Spencer are discussing Jessica's phone call with Peter , the two get emails from her saying she wants to do lunch, a development that surprises them all.  The Liars meet with Jessica , despite their awkward reservations. The subject shifts to Jason and his moving back in; Jessica reveals she doesn't think of the house in Rosewood as their family's anymore, but as Jason is paying for the house himself, she has little choice but to respect her son's decision. She then presents the girls with presents - four high-fashion dresses. The girls are uneasy, however, as they remember Alison having picked them out and trying them on in a flashback.
